3293260.name: Waterpark Simulator
3293260.detailed_description:
Waterpark Simulator is a first-person management simulator. Design, build, and manage your own waterpark. From crazy slides to tasty snacks, every detail is yours to control. Play solo or bring friends along for the ultimate chaotic adventure!

Feeling lonely in your dream waterpark? Bring your friends along for the ride. Work together to create the ultimate waterpark… or wreak havoc with your friends! 

Make your waterpark uniquely yours: design and build custom slides to your heart’s content. Design crazy slide loops and spirals for fun… or mayhem!

It’s time to work your way to THE ULTIMATE Waterpark with a diamond rating! Complete new quests and objectives to earn NEW decor and themed items and an even BIGGER park.

A whole new zone to play in! This new area features a new city backdrop, new park entrance, and new building zones.

Want to run your Waterpark as the night shift? Now you can run your Waterpark with a whole new vibe and beautiful glow at night by extending your day to night time!

Just like your waterpark, you can make your character uniquely yours with multiple character save slots for different vibes! 

Say hello to security and mascots! Security will help boot out those unruly guests while mascots will bring more fun and hype for your guests.

Short on funds? Need a loan? The Mafia can help you out…. For a price.

All this and more now available in 1.0!

Create custom waterslides, unique pools, themed attractions, and everything else a fun, functional waterpark needs.

Spray your guests with water guns, launch beach balls at their heads, or maybe give a nervous diver a “gentle” push off the board. It’s your park you make the rules!

In the beginning, it’s all on you. From selling tickets, serving food, saving drowning guests, fixing broken slides, cleaning up after visitors, to scooping poop out of the pool. It’s chaotic, hands-on, and all part of running a successful waterpark.

Paint walls and slides, spray custom designs onto any surface, and swap out flooring to set the tone of each area. Add props, signs, and decorations to give your park a personal touch and make every corner feel uniquely yours.

Launch guests into the air, send them flying into pools, or watch them flop helplessly after slipping on a puddle. Ragdoll physics turn every moment into a potential comedy highlight.

Keep your guests happy by setting up food stands and vending machines around your park. Prepare hot dogs, lemonade, ice cream and more! The better the treats, the happier the visitors. 

Everything you do affects your park’s overall rating from how clean it is, to how fun your slides are, to the quality of your food and amenities. The happier your guests are, the better your rating. Keep them satisfied and they’ll stay longer, spend more, and want to come back.

As your park gets more popular, it’s time to expand. Unlock new areas to grow your waterpark’s size and hire staff to handle the daily chaos. With a team in place, you can focus on what really matters: building the best waterpark possible.

No AI was used in the making of this game. We pay artists for all our assets and marketing images/ videos, translation teams, devs, etc. We are proud to be a 100% human-made game.

3314340.name: Burgie's Cozy Kitchen
3314340.detailed_description:
Burgie’s Cozy Kitchen is an ACTIVE cozy desktop companion game where you run a wholesome burger stand that lives on your screen, trying to recreate a real burger joint where you can do other things during slowtimes while waiting for customers to arrive.

Serve customers, upgrade your kitchen, and watch your little burger shop grow at your own pace.

✨  A cute desktop game that fits into your day

Play actively, or keep it running in the corner of your screen while you work, study, or watch YouTube. A bell will ring when new orders arrive, turning your breaks into something fun and satisfying.

🕹️ Different ways to play

🔥 Frenetic: Play actively with constant impatient picky customers.

☕ Relax: Minimize the game, attending to customers every 5-15 minutes, and brighten your day with short breaks.

📚 Pomodoro: Minimize the game, set the timer, and a new customer will notify you when it's time to take a break. Ideal as a gamified focus tool.

🤩 Streamer: Combine the chaos of the frenetic mode with your stream. Viewers can play through your livestream chat with a simple command and place the craziest order they can think of. They'll also complain if you mess up!

You can connect the game to your YouTube, Kick, Tiktok, or Twitch chat to receive your own viewers and their orders. You can chat individually with your viewers, serve them any food you want, and much more! They'll also affect your reviews, helping (or not) you climb the global Streamers ranking.

3326230.name: Hozy
3326230.detailed_description:
Roadmap


Just Updated

Hozy is constantly being updated with new content and improvements based on your feedback, and here’s what’s new in our latest major update:

Game Plus

Experience familiar rooms from a new perspective! All levels now have an alternative version. Once you’ve finished Hozy’s main story, you’ll be able to reselect any of your previously completed levels and enter the Game Plus version of the room, with totally different furniture (and occupants!) than the original one.

Sandbox Mode

This is our first iteration of Sandbox Mode, and it will continue to evolve based on your feedback!

Design your own cozy room worthy of an interior design magazine by changing various elements like wallpapers, paint colours, window frames and flooring designs! Furnish it with any decor or furniture available in the game to create something truly unique and yours!

Choose What to Unpack

Have more control over what you are placing in your rooms! You can now preview furniture and decor items in the boxes and decide which to take out first.


About the Game

After things don’t quite work out in the big city, you return to your small hometown. Once lively, it now feels a little faded and forgotten. In that stillness, you discover something unexpected: a new passion. Room by room, space by space, you clean, paint, and gently restore the sense of community that once filled these streets.

Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you're wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Open a window to let the wind play with floating dust and bring nature's sounds closer. Light candles, arrange books on shelves, paint a portrait on the wall, or switch on a projector. Everything you touch and every choice you make delivers a sense of satisfaction and a gentle “aha!” moment.

Hozy features nine unique locations to explore and restore. Each space is filled with its residents' personal stories, as well as unique objects and small details that make every room feel lived in. Begin your journey in your parents’ home, step into an artist’s workshop, then visit an old café full of memories. Explore dreamlike spaces and help fulfil your father’s long-held dream of a peaceful place by the sea.

Skip the endless catalogue overwhelm. Hozy offers a carefully curated selection of furniture and décor for each level that work well together. Place items freely, rotate and arrange them however you like – there is no right or wrong and no room is ever the same. Use the tools at your disposal wisely, and you'll create spaces worthy of an interior-design magazine!

- A variety of spaces to restore and furnish at your own pace and with no limits

- A wide range of cleaning and renovation tools to use, like a mop, squeegee, crowbar, and more

- Deeply satisfying physics-based cleaning gameplay

- Carefully curated furniture and décor, designed to always look great together

- Endless replayability, driven by freedom of creativity and tiny details

- A versatile photo mode with filters and advanced camera controls

- Original charming soundtrack by the composer of Stray and Seasons After Fall

3330210.name: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron
3330210.detailed_description:
Out Now, Check out the Bundle! 🏹


About the Game

A Cosmic Culinary Adventure Begins!

You are the one and only witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, an intergalactic restaurant like no other. Standing before the legendary Cosmic Cauldron, your mission is to serve the most delectable stews to a host of bizarre extraterrestrial patrons. But beware, failure is not an option. If your dishes don’t satisfy... You might just become the next ingredient!

Features

  • 🔥 Deck-Building Roguelike Cooking System

    Each dish is a high-stakes gamble! With 20 different ingredients dropping into the cauldron every run, watch them collide and combine in unexpected ways to rack up points. Every cooking session introduces new ingredients, pushing you to build a strategic deck and create powerful synergies.

  • 🌌 Cosmic Cooking Challenges

    Brace yourself for an intergalactic kitchen frenzy! The ingredients won’t just sit still. They’ll tumble, crash, and react in chaotic ways. Hit the target score quickly to earn bonus rewards like Cauldron Expansions and powerful Cosmic Relics that enhance your cooking prowess.

  • 🧙‍♀️ A Whimsical Witch’s Tale

    Your restaurant attracts customers from the farthest corners of the universe, eldritch beings with impossible demands and unrelenting appetites. If you fail to meet their expectations... well, let’s just say the consequences are cosmic-scale catastrophes.

  • ✨ Charming 2D Cosmic Pixel Art

    Immerse yourself in a hand-drawn pixel-art world that’s both cute and mysterious! Every detail, from animated ingredients to enchanting space backgrounds, brings your cosmic kitchen to life.

Gameplay Highlights

  • 🍲 Ingredient Drop & Interaction

    Ingredients fall randomly into the cauldron, bouncing, merging, and triggering unpredictable reactions. Adapt on the fly, strategize your deck, and make every dish a masterpiece.

  • 🍽️ Strategic Deck-Building

    Collect ingredients and craft your unique deck. With a vast array of ingredient types and properties, experimenting with different combinations is key to achieving high scores and mastering the art of cosmic cuisine.

  • 🏆 Rewards & Upgrades

    Meet your goals to unlock cauldron upgrades and rare relics that amplify ingredient interactions. Discover faster, more efficient ways to cook and dominate the interstellar culinary scene!

Are you ready to cook up the universe’s most legendary stew? Don't forget to wishlist our game!

3357960.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
3357960.detailed_description:
Steam Deck Verified


2026 Roadmap


About the Game

Ready to battle for the title of top eatery? Yes, Chef! 

You’ve just inherited your grandma’s once-famous meatball restaurant in the cozy town of KuloNiku. Now it’s up to you to bring it back to glory as the top eatery! Take on eccentric orders from townsfolk, serve delicious meals, and restore your family’s legacy.

Beware—there’s fierce competition from the town’s flashiest rival: Souper Starz, run by the menacing rockstar chef, Stella!

  • Chop, boil, fry, torch, pour, sizzle, slice, and skewer, and more with immersive, tactile controls that make every action tickle your brain and make your mouth water.

  • Want to add an extra punch of garlic or a sprinkle of salt? Go for it. You’re the chef – find multiple ways to prepare your customers the perfect dish and rack up those juicy tips! 💰

  • But your customers aren’t just customers. Some may become your friends 🤝, rivals ⚔️, or even part of your story 📖.

  • Rival chefs want the top spot, and there’s only one way to settle things: Meatball Brawls!

  • In these thrilling culinary duels, you’ll go head-to-head to impress a panel of rotating judges. It’s not just about speed - it’s about strategy, creativity, and mastering every step of the cooking process.

  • Play mini-games to impress both the judges and the crowd watching live, who will issue on-the-spot requests to boost your score!

  • Keep things fresh! Unlock new tools, purchase higher-quality ingredients, and discover brand-new recipes to keep your menu exciting.

  • Personalize your restaurant with fun decorations in a variety of styles - even buy full sets! Decor isn’t just cosmetic; some items give gameplay perks to impress your customers.

  • Unlock special decorations by playing in special festivals or raising your friendship level with town residents!

  • An eclectic cast of characters awaits you in KuloNiku - No matter friend or rival (or both??), they've all got stories to tell!

  • Raise your friendship level with a cast of companions to unlock special illustrations and decorations.

  • Uncover the mystery of your eye-raising past and save your grandmother's restaurant alongside your friends!

3373660.name: Look Outside
3373660.detailed_description:
Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters - human and otherwise.

Survival Horror & Resource Management

Plan tense expeditions outside your apartment as you fend off grotesque monsters dwelling in and around your building. Return to your home with gathered resources and partial answers to your questions to recuperate by playing games, making dinner, crafting tools, and getting to know your neighbors turned allies.

Inventive Turn-Based Combat

Clash with over 150 hand-crafted creatures in turn-based combat that accounts for space between you and your foes as you wield makeshift weapons and items you've gathered in the corridors of the building.

Impeccable Body Horror Aesthetic

Meet your macabre fate in a bizarre world teeming with an unconventional and occasionally psychotic cast of characters - some of which you can recruit and offer safe harbor in your apartment as the mystery unravels.

Small, Experimental, and Unwaveringly Weird

Offering 10 - 12 hours of playtime with a dozen boss encounters, friends to recruit, and visitors to invite back to your home, Look Outside offers different experiences for every player on their way to uncover several different endings.

3376500.name: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
3376500.detailed_description:
Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a short game where you experiment in the kitchen.

You can drag, toss, and combine ingredients in fun and surprising ways, to fill your cookbook with over 300 recipes, ranging from the gourmet to the gross. The game is about 3 hours long.

KITCHEN SANDBOX

Get messy in the kitchen! Everything has weight, motion and personality. Drag and drop items, or throw them around. So, mix and match, toss and break things to complete your to do list. 

COUNTLESS SECRETS

Not all ingredients are easy to find. Every cabinet and shelf is chock-full of hidden ingredients waiting to be uncovered. Some are hidden, others are locked away, and solving these puzzles might mean thinking creatively.

CHAOTIC ACHIEVEMENTS

Behind every kitchen nook and cranny are achievements that reward you for bending the rules of the kitchen. To solve the game’s most challenging puzzles, players will need to throw out the recipe book, roll up their sleeves, and think outside the box.

FEATURES:

  • Around 3 hour of playtime to complete all 3 levels in 3 different kitchens.

  • Cook everything from comfort foods and gourmet dishes to strange, surprising experiments.

  • Play with satisfying physics as every ingredient and object reacts in fun, surprising ways.

  • Solve playful kitchen puzzles to uncover hidden ingredients, secrets, and new ways to cook.

  • Collect fun achievements that reward curiosity, chaos, and breaking the rules.

  • Follow a heartfelt story by unlocking each recipe.

THE TEAM

Hello! We are a small group of friends who wanted to make a cute game about cooking. We started this project in the end of 2024 and this will be is our first commercial release!

Our team is Julien (game designer & co-creator), Erika (artist & co-creator), Danny (programmer) and Kristin (narrative desiger) and Tumult Kollective (audio design).

Most of us work on this project part time but we love experimenting, learning, and pushing their ideas as far as their own skills, time, and personal investment allow us. And we hope you will enjoy our creation :)

3376990.name: Kabuto Park
3376990.detailed_description:
Kabuto Park is a cute and short bug collection game. Spend a month as Hana, a little girl on summer vacation. Catch the best bugs and level them up, choose your team carefully and fight other kids to become the Summer Beetle Battles champion.

Expect 2 to 4 hours of serene bug catching, exciting little battles and summer vibes.

Catch cute bugs 🦋✨

Beetles! Butterflies! Bees! Dragonflies! And many more! Discover more than 40 cool bug species that live in Kabuto Park and try to catch them by timing your net swings right.

Win the tiniest sumo fights 💪🪲

Choose your team depending on their stats, abilities or look and show other kids who the best beetle battler is! Each bug you select for your team will add cards to your deck that you'll be able to use during the little fights. Try to push your opponents out of the ring.

Your rhino beetle is not strong enough? Feed it candies to level it up and you'll have better luck winning the next fight!

Buy cool stuff 🔍📗

Better boots or a better net will surely make you the best bug catcher! Lucky for you, the local store has everything you need to get access to new areas with new bugs, make rare bugs appear more often or make capture easier.

Features 🎮

🪲 What Kabuto Park offers:

  • A short creature collector: With 2 to 4 hours of playtime, this game is a perfect snack for an afternoon or a few sessions here and there. I like to keep my game short, to the point and respectful of players' time.

  • Simple game mechanics: A relaxing capture mini game, little bug battles with a simple deck building gameplay, a light upgrade system and a leveling system to upgrade your favorite critters.

  • A cozy mood: Summer vibes, childlike wonder, cute art and lovely music!

  • The cutest bugs: Bugs from all around the world are here and ready to become your friend. You can even pet them in your terrarium!

🐞 What Kabuto Park does NOT offer:

  • No Exploration or moving around in the world.

  • No big adventure with quests and a long plot.

  • No multiplayer of any kind. No PVP, no trading.

  • No spiders. That one is for you arachnophobes.

Dev team 🐛🐞

Hey, I'm Doot and I'm back with Zakku for another tiny game ✨

We are the developer and music composer of Minami Lane and Froggy's Battle, still on our quest to bring more tiny cute games to the world! Trained and helped by Minami Lane's artist Blibloop, I made the art by myself this time (please don't be mean I'm trying my best).

We really hope you'll enjoy our little game 💖

3399960.name: Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi
3399960.detailed_description:
Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! A laid back fishing idler that lives on your desktop, along the bottom of your screen, or just about anywhere else you'd like. Take a moment to ease your mind as you take in the sea breeze, and wait for a bite! In Fish to Dish, you're a fisherman taking to the seas to reel in weird and wonderful creatures of the deep, and then serve them up as sushi. All kinds of customers await, their bellies rumbling... So upgrade your rod, unlock new bait, sail the seas, and even build your own aquarium tank!

• Start a relaxing fishing adventure from the bottom of your desktop screen. Watch as your boat sails the waves, reeling in new fish. Tap your keyboard or click your mouse to speed up the bite and reel in fish even faster!

• Play at your own pace, and feel that sense of satisfaction as your boat heaves with awesome catches!Tap your keyboard or click your mouse to speed up the bite and reel in fish even faster!

• Cast your rod in a range of bays and isles, each with their own unique sea life. You'll see everything from everyday fish, to rare leviathans of the depths.

• What's that floating over there...? Spot starfish, turtles, walruses, even rubber ducks and much more floating out on the waves!

• Fill out your bestiary as you haul in new species, and expand your sushi bar's menu.

• Prepare your prize catches, and sell a delectable range of sushi dishes to earn gold.

• Level up your sushi bar and spruce it up with furniture and decorations. Make it your own to draw in all kinds of customers, and... cats?

• Buy rod upgrades to fish more efficiently, and return to shore with a deck chock-full of fish!

• Pick out the right bait for the fish you're after, and reel in elusive rare varieties.

• Float in relaxation, taking in the joy of fishing as the tides ebb and flow.

• Fill the hatchery with catches, and gaze over your rare fish as they flit within an aquarium ecosystem of your own creation.

• Bid stress farewell, and be at one with nature in Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi. Take time to fish at your leisure!

Game FAQ

Q: Screen flickering after Steam pop-up or pressing Shift+Tab?

A: Disable the Steam Overlay: Right-click Fish to Dish in your game library → Properties → General → Uncheck "Enable Steam Overlay while in-game." This only affects this game; others are unaffected.

Q: Game background is black?

A: Visit the store page → "Discussions" for a solution in the pinned post.

Q: Can DEMO save files be carried over to the full version?

A: No, carrying over saves may cause bugs.

3416070.name: Ropuka's Idle Island
3416070.detailed_description:
Ropuka's Idle Island is a playable sticker for your desktop. Put it anywhere on your screen and focus on work or fun while the little frog tends to his garden.

Cut grass

While not sleeping, Ropuka is always cutting grass. Use it as a currency to upgrade his tools, improve the grass' quality or spend it decorating the island.

Decorate

Unlock new buildings and plants to create your own unique island. Can you get every item and complete the collection?

Co-working buddy

Ropuka's Idle Island is the perfect game for multitasking. Put it anywhere you want on the screen, resize to take as little or as much space as you want, and the little frog buddy will always be with you when you work, play games, or relax.

Lofi and ambient music modes 

If you need help focusing, Ropuka's Idle Island includes a custom-made lofi track and ambient sounds of nature. Mix and match the audio sources or play in silence to create the perfect workspace.

3422270.name: Terra Firma 2
3422270.detailed_description:
Terra Firma 2 is a powerful simulation of natural forces, giving you the creative freedom to sculpt entire worlds to your liking. Use intuitive tools to alter terrain, adjust rainfall, change temperatures, and tweak tectonic activity.

Your changes set the stage, but the simulation takes over—generating lifelike rivers, eroding mountains, growing forests, and populating ecosystems down to individual plants and animals.

Harnessing the full power of modern GPUs, Terra Firma 2 simulates worlds at an unprecedented scale. Maps can span up to 16,000 km², simulating centuries of natural evolution in seconds, all while allowing you to zoom in to observe wildlife and terrain changes in real time.

Raise and Lower Tectonic Plates

Simulate the slow but powerful forces that shape continents. With full tectonic modeling, you can create convergent boundaries that build towering mountain ranges, divergent ones that split the land into rift valleys, and transform boundaries shift massive landmasses.

Experiment with Dynamic Ecosystems

Life in Terra Firma 2 emerges organically based on the world you create. Plants and animals respond to local conditions such as moisture, temperature, and elevation, resulting in rich ecosystems that feel alive. From boreal forests to mangroves, deserts to alpine tundra, the variety is shaped entirely by your choices.

Alter the Environment with Complete Climate Control

Take command of world’s climate with the ability to modify rainfall and temperature to create seasonal variations. Melt the snowcaps off the tallest mountain and watch the water flow down to raise the water level, or change the rainfall to see different biomes flourish.

Worlds created in Terra Firma 2 are able to be saved, loaded, and exported to other systems, either as heightmaps or via an exporter to your favourite voxel based game.

3430450.name: Zombie Graveyard Simulator
3430450.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

In a world where the dead turn into zombies, your job is to manage your very own Graveyard! Perform burials and cremations, fulfill visitor requests, manage facilities, and keep your staff and defenses in top shape. But when night falls, everything changes. The dead may rest, but the zombies don’t. They are coming for your precious work!

Visitor Satisfaction is Key

After processing the bodies, visitors will return to check on their loved ones. Your duty is to keep graves intact while providing fresh flowers and maintaining a welcoming environment. Every visit rewards you with valuable bonuses to help your business thrive.

Visitors can also stop by the Chapel to rest, attend sermons, and browse the Souvenir Shop for small keepsakes like candles and incenses. A clean, decorated, and well managed graveyard encourages greater generosity while donating!

Build your Defenses

Each night, waves of zombies will come with their numbers growing and special zombie types emerging, hungry for freshly buried bodies and for you. Some nights may be even more dangerous with special events like the Blood Moon. From basic defenses like barbed wires and fences to advanced machines like flamethrower turrets, keep your defenses upgraded, repaired, and fully stocked with ammo to withstand the night. Your loyal pet companion can also assist you during nighttime defenses.

Trust your Arsenal

With a wide arsenal of 13+ weapons, including pistols, rifles, shotguns, and your trusty shovel, you are the ultimate force against the Zombies. As you level up, unlock and purchase new weapons to become even stronger. Just make sure to stock up on enough ammo!

Even a Graveyard Can Be Cozy Sometimes!

Use your Farming Area to grow different flowers for profit and vegetables to simply eat and restore your energy and health. With Upgrades, you can even unlock a Grinder to turn zombie parts into Fertilizer. Decorate your Graveyard with benches, lights, paths, custom urns, and other ornaments to make it truly your own.

Expand and Upgrade Your Facilities

Your graveyard isn’t just a resting place, it's a business, and every upgrade matters. Expand your burial areas, manage custom urns at the urn station, upgrade your crematorium, and operate new facilities like the Stone Quarry & Workshop to craft your own gravestones. Improve your water supply, manage resource production, and unlock advanced stations like the Zombie Research Lab to process captured zombies into valuable products.

Hire a team of employees to help with day-to-day tasks: the Florist keeps flowers running, the Gravekeeper maintains burials and cremations, the Gardener keeps your farm in check, the Technician ensures all machines run smoothly, and Chapel staff like the Priest, Pianist, and Custodian help run sermons and services.

Every improvement helps you stay one step ahead of both business demands and the undead threat. Venture beyond the graveyard by unlocking Expedition Mode through the Expedition Station, where radio signals lead you to dangerous missions outside your walls.

Key Features

  • Manage and expand your own graveyard while balancing business and survival

  • Build and maintain defenses against nightly zombie attacks

  • Perform burials, cremations, urn deliveries, and keep visitors satisfied

  • Operate a Chapel with sermons, donations, and a Souvenir Shop

  • Hire and manage a wide range of employees

  • Craft gravestones, customize urns, and produce valuable resources

  • Unlock Expedition Mode and complete missions outside the graveyard

  • Decorate your Graveyard with benches, lights, paths, bushes and other ornaments to make it truly your own

  • Customize your playstyle with expanded game modifier

  • Experience a mix of management, strategy, and first-person action

3458180.name: Dungeon Bodega Simulator
3458180.detailed_description:
Dungeon Bodega Simulator is a short simulation game where you run a small shop in the aforementioned dungeon while growing crops, raising pet dungeon slimes, serving customers, and brewing potions. Choose how to expand and upgrade your bodega while getting to know the locals!

Play as Elm Myrkwater, a recently laid off adventurer who was gifted the bodega by a distant uncle and trying to turn this cold prison into a welcoming supply spot for adventurers and locals.

  • 3-4 hour main story with 24 in-game days

  • Grow crops and process them into items for adventurers.

  • Sell items to friendly customers and dungeon dwellers.

  • Brew potions and turn your crops into sought after elixirs.

  • Forge expensive weapons and tools to sell.

  • Day/night cycle, spend as much time as you like setting up your shop.

  • Get dungeon slimes you can keep as pets.

  • Befriend your regulars and solve puzzles in a dungeon mystery.

  • Retro Style graphics

  • Twitch integration

  • Infinite mode after main story is complete

You'll be able to enjoy 8+ different unique crop types that you can turn into a variety of potions and products for your customers. 

The dungeon is full of creatures both nice and gnarly, and your customers will need some assistance! Brew different potions and sell them for a significant amount of gold.

Get to know your regulars, learn about the dungeon, and take care of your customers needs while you run your shop. In the full release you'll be able to unlock new types of customers as you improve and upgrade your bodega.

The dungeon may be home to many dangerous creatures, but your pet slimes are exceptionally sweet! These lil guys also serve a valuable purpose, turning unused items into potions. Slimes are not picky eaters but are quite hungry!

We couldn't forget the most important part about running a bodega, petting the bodega cat!

3467040.name: Bookshop Simulator
3467040.detailed_description:
Fulfill your dream of owning and operating your own bookshop. Buy and sell inventory and use the profits to decorate and expand your shop. Build your business from a small boutique shop into a retail empire!

Buy and place bookshelves, then fill them with new books, comics, board games, and other items to sell. Run the cash register to earn revenue. As your business grows, hire employees to be cashiers and item stockers so you can focus on expansion.

Expand your reach to new locations around the world. Use your income from established shops to help set up new shops. Travel between shops to manage them and optimize your profits. Early access will launch with the France and Japan locations.

Use your profits to customize your store. Choose walls and floors. Decorate with rugs, plants, wall art, and more! Create specialized sections for your favorite genre, or build cozy book nooks.

Get boxes of used books that may contain rare mythical books. These books have powerful abilities to improve your profits and capabilities.

Adopt a cat to keep you and your customers company every day in the shop. Buy food, a bed, and other items to keep the cat active and happy in the store.

3468400.name: Log Away
3468400.detailed_description:
Travel to peaceful Retreats in changing seasons and weather. Build, decorate, and furnish at your own pace, and collect Keepsakes with softly narrated backstories. No grind. No pressure. Just nature, animals, and time to breathe.

  • Quiet places to exhale: seaside coves, inland meadows, and mountain hideaways across fall, winter, and summer—each with a different mood in the light and weather.

  • As lamps glow and corners gather comfort, you feel the room warm around you, the retreat growing cozier with every thoughtful touch.

  • What you love matters: the interests you choose color what appears and which quiet stories surface, so discoveries feel aligned with you.

  • Some Keepsakes carry softly narrated memories; together they settle into your Keepsakes collection—an album‑like place you can revisit whenever you need a reminder.

  • A calming acoustic score and natural soundscapes lift the mood and immerse you in the environment.

  • Choose a retreat and settle in as the time of day and weather drift softly around you.

  • Select up to three interests (from ten). They gently shape decorating and furnishing options and nudge later discoveries, including which Keepsakes you’ll uncover, without locking you in.

  • Decorate at your own pace. Place, rotate, and refine with lamps, chairs, plants, and more, shaping the mood indoors and out.

  • Fill your Cozy Heart. As the space truly warms, your Cozy Heart reaches full; when it does, travel bags arrive with new Keepsakes to unpack and arrange. It’s a reflection of coziness, not a pressure meter.

  • Revisit your Keepsakes collection to browse what you’ve found and hear gentle backstories again, whenever you like.

  • Return anytime to tidy, tweak, and enjoy the quiet of your retreats, or start a new one.

  • Listen to an acoustic soundtrack with over 20 tracks composed by Chris Haugen, crafted to slow the world around you.

  • Personalize every moment with the Cozy Tools: capture breathtaking screenshots in Photo Mode, control the weather, change the time of day, and switch between visual styles for a unique vibe.

Log Away is a game about coming back to yourself: simple moments, small comforts, the hush of rain on the window and a lamp glowing at dusk… No meters to chase. No timers. Just a retreat that waits for you, ready whenever you need to breathe.

Cast n Chill's a laid-back fishin’ game for folks who’d rather wet a line than break a sweat. Whether yer driftin’ on a lazy lake, pokin’ 'round a winding river, or droppin’ lines in salty blue water, this here’s a game where you set the pace.

Upgrade Yer Gear

Start with the basics, catch whatever bites, sell your haul, and put those coins toward better rods, reels, and upgrades. Before ya know it, you’ll be wranglin’ rare species that’d make any angler green with envy.

Explore New Waters

Find yer favourite fishin’ hole or keep wanderin’. There’s 16 peaceful spots to discover, each with its own critters swimmin’ 'round, just waitin’ to bite.

Pick Your Pace

In Active Mode, you’re in the thick of it - castin’, reelin’, and keepin’ busy like a loon at nesting time.

Switch to Passive Mode if you’d rather let the game do the work while you’re off choppin’ wood.

Set it up on a second monitor or tuck it in the corner - come back later and see what kind o’ haul the fish gods left ya.

Collect 'Em All

There’s 50+ fish to discover - some you’ll recognize, some you’ll squint at and go “what in the heck is that?” From scrappy little sunfish to big ol’ deepwater beasts, they’re all in the logbook waitin’ for your name.

Legendary Catches

There’s 16 fish out there that still get folks jabberin’ at ol' Rusty's bait shop like they saw Bigfoot ride a moose. Land one, and you'll be part o' the legend.

Boat Buddies

Grab your rod and call a buddy, Cast 'n Chill now has co-op! Whether you’re lookin’ to kick back and fish side-by-side or stir up a bit of friendly competition, it’s all better with company.

Trusty Companion

Nothin’ beats a day on the lake with a four-legged friend. They might not know a spinnerbait from a spoon, but they’ll help you spot a fish - if only 'cause they’re hopin’ for a bite themselves.

Restore Your Very Own Fishing Cabin

Roll up your sleeves and bring a worn down lakeside shack back to life, then kick back and enjoy the quiet while fishin’ off your own dock. Stock your pond, mount replicas of your best catches, and settle in while your trusty companion curls up by the fire.

3493540.name: Transport Fever 3
3493540.detailed_description:
Deluxe Edition & Pre-Purchase Offer

The Transport Fever 3: Deluxe Edition allows you to take your network to the next level with iconic vehicles, more world-famous landmarks, and new unique wildlife from around the globe to your base game.

The Deluxe Edition contains:

Six Legendary Vehicles for Land, and Air:

  • Concorde: fastest passenger airplane of all times

  • London Bus: timeless symbol of public transport

  • Trans-Europe Express: milestone of luxury rail travel

  • Peterbilt 359: legend of trucking power and endurance

  • Hong Kong Tram: iconic double-decker streetcar 

  • Sikorsky S-76 Spirit: the go-to helicopter for highest comfort standards

Two Architectural Wonders From Around the Globe:

  • Eiffel Tower: icon of European architecture

  • Taj Mahal: masterpiece of the world's heritage

Four Wild Animals Representing Different Climate Zones:

  • Orca: dangerous ruler of the subarctic oceans

  • Komodo Dragon: apex predator of the tropical islands

  • Boar Family: resilient inhabitants of the temperate forests

  • Bison: calm giant of the dry grasslands

Three New Handcrafted Maps For All Kind of Challenges:

  • Redrock Bends: conquer winding rivers, steep canyons, and growing transport challenges

  • Northern Gates: navigate dramatic fjords, scattered islands, and impassable mountain barriers

  • Emerald Shores: balance costly infrastructure and waterways across volcanic island paradises

Additional Extras For Even More Fun:

  • Tycoon Cars: bring the road traffic to the next level

  • Fun Elements: 3 additional catchy elements to discover in-game 

  • Franchise Soundtracks: build your network to the tunes of all our previous titles


Pre-Purchase Offer

Pre-purchase Transport Fever 3 now to get the exclusive content that adds iconic scale and atmosphere to your world:

A Brand-New Historical Vehicle:

  • TS Queen Mary: legendary ocean liner, meticulously recreated in stunning detail

A World-Famous Landmark:

  • Great Pyramid: most iconic wonder of the ancient world

A Majestic Wildlife Addition:

  • Asian elephant: majestic symbol of strength and life in tropical regions


About the Game

Plan, build, and optimize! Transport Fever 3 puts you in charge of your own transport empire. From humble beginnings with horse-drawn wagons, steam trains, and paddle-steamers working towards the latest jet planes, supertankers, high-speed trains, and helicopters, you will build the network that drives the world!

Every delivery earns money, while every train, truck, plane, or ship increases your costs. You’ll plan and build profitable routes, balance infrastructure expenses, and invest in upgrades to stay ahead of growing demand.

With success comes the financial freedom to expand your reach, while earning the right to build world famous landmarks to demonstrate your achievements. Fall short, and you’ll be seeking efficiencies and improvements to propel your company forward.

As your influence expands, the needs of every city become more challenging to fulfill. There's no such thing as one plan that works forever, you will need to adapt, overcome, and solve problems as they come up, balancing your desire for growth with the needs of the populations you serve.

BECOME THE TYCOON

Build your personal transport empire by creating perfect routes to maximise your profits. Ensure that cargo and people get where they need to be, when they need to be. Manage and optimize your vehicle fleet, balance maintenance costs, efficiency, and priorities. Resolve bottlenecks and meet the evolving demands of dynamic towns and a multitude of industries that operate on- and offshore. Develop commercial centers, industrial powerhouses, and commuter cities by specializing deliveries and mastering every transport decision.

CONNECT THE WORLD

Connect towns and industries to fuel their growth. Plan and construct rails, roads, sea- and airways to build your transport empire. Grow tiny villages into major cities as you master traffic priorities and management systems. Analyze trouble using data layers and visual displays to identify traffic hotspots, delivery problems, or excessive noise and pollution. Make use of intuitive building tools to further optimize your network and grow from small country roads to highways and from old-wooden rails to modern high-speed tracks.

EXPERIENCE A LIVING SIMULATION

Every citizen has a home, a job, and places to go in the expanded living simulation, letting you follow each one along the way. Dynamic weather and a full day-night cycle let you experience your world in countless moods, from sunny mornings to rainy, clouded afternoons. Each of the four climate zones brings unique challenges, from temperate valleys and subarctic swamps, to desert plains and tropical islands, all demanding a fresh approach to your transportation strategy.​

PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Customize your game with multiple difficulty options, enabling you to create your perfect game. Adjust the way the world, economy, and its citizens react to your style of play. Design ultimate tycoon adversity, that will test you to the limit, as you race to complete contract objectives in the fastest possible time. Ease the difficulty to a more relaxed setting and play for fun, or disable the economy entirely and build the most stunning city, station, or diorama you can imagine.

WRITE TRANSPORT HISTORY

Solve epic transport missions from history that will test your planning, efficiency, and cunning in the extensive story campaign. Immerse in the full tycoon experience, making use of the largest range of vehicles in the series that spans over a century of transport evolution. The whole world, including buildings, people, and cars, follow designs and trends through time. Rewrite transportation history and run steam trains and jets side by side as you progress through the 20th century and beyond.

CREATE WITHOUT LIMITS

Modding tools have been greatly improved, enabling mod creators to bring their favourite vehicles, buildings, and infrastructure to life. The fully featured in-game map editor allows anyone to craft maps closely matching reality or drawn from your wildest imagination. Share your creations or expand your collection and the scope of your worlds with ease using the in-game mod browser, expanding the range of possibilities in directions that will keep your experience fresh again and again.

BUILT ON WHAT WORKS

Transport Fever 3 builds on everything that has made the series a favorite among transport and tycoon fans for years. Every system has been refined, every feature expanded, and every tool streamlined to deliver the most complete and rewarding experience yet. With smarter cities, deeper logistics, improved performance, and an even greater focus on tycoon gameplay, it’s the ultimate evolution of a proven formula, built for both newcomers and veterans to enjoy for years to come.

FEATURE OVERVIEW

  • Tycoon mode with highly-adjustable difficulty to set the perfect level of challenge

  • Sandbox mode to build with unrestricted creativity and strong mod support

  • Campaign mode featuring entertaining missions inspired by real historic events

  • Map editor to design comprehensive maps in-game and accessible modification tools

  • Wide range of tricky achievements with unique goals and rewarding challenges

  • More than 125 years of transport evolution - from horse-drawn wagons to high-speed trains

  • 275+ realistic vehicles such as trains, buses, trams, trucks, ships, aircraft and helicopters

  • All major transport types covered, including light rail systems and dedicated cargo trams

  • Modular infrastructure spanning multiple eras - from classic train stations to modern airports

  • Physically-based atmosphere and cloud-coverage, day/night cycle and dynamic lighting

  • Multiple highly immersive climate zones, including a brand new subarctic region

  • Randomly generated maps with distinct biomes that offer unique game-play challenges

  • Town growth featuring dynamic districts based on simulating individual inhabitants

  • Advanced traffic simulation with lane control and realistic behavior such as overtaking

  • Landmarks inspired by real-world architecture, adding character to towns and regions

  • Over 35 unique industries, including off-shore sectors such as fishing grounds and oil platforms

  • Demand-driven industry expansion with production boosted by workers and optional inputs

  • Redesigned cargo simulation providing full control over loading and unloading

  • Warehouses and specialized terminals for intermediate storage and logistics optimization

  • Dynamic loan and contract system offering risk versus reward opportunities

  • Simple yet deep game mechanics based on maintenance, noise/pollution, reputation and more

  • Extensive customization options ensuring a high replay value and diverse play styles

  • Powerful road and track construction tools including overland trams and highway ramps

  • Flexible road design options with individual tram lanes and configurable lane connections

  • Intuitive landscaping tools for terrain sculpting, ground painting and vegetation placement

  • Cross-platform modding support with in-game mod browser for easy content discovery

3496000.name: Ship, Inc.
3496000.detailed_description:
Save more with bundle!


About the Game

Ever wanted to step into the shoes of a packaging expert? In Ship, Inc., you take on the role of a packaging employee at a fast-paced cargo shipment company. Your job? Sort, package, and ship parcels to their correct destinations while keeping up with the growing demands of the business.

How It Works

At Ship, Inc., every package counts! Follow shipment orders carefully, choose the right box sizes, and ensure each package reaches its destination safely. Misplacing or damaging shipments could cost you, so be precise and efficient!

Key Features

📦 Cozy & Wholesome Packaging System – Select the correct box size, arrange items properly, and seal them securely before shipping.

📋 Order Processing – Keep an eye on incoming orders and ship parcels correctly to maximize efficiency.

🧰 Upgrade Your Office – Earn money to improve your workspace, increase storage, and unlock better shipping tools.

⏱️ Time Management Challenges – Stay on top of customer demands as you balance speed and accuracy in your shipments.

💥 Deliver With Care – Packages must be handled properly! Fragile items require extra attention to avoid damage during transit.

🚀 Dynamic Difficulty – As you progress, new challenges and complex orders will test your multitasking skills.

Run a Successful Wholesome Shipping Business

Every second counts in the shipping industry! Improve your workflow, make the right decisions, and prove yourself as the best packaging expert in Ship, Inc.. Are you up for the challenge?

Different Game Modes

Ship, Inc. includes 3 different modes (difficulty based modes) that invites all players.

  • 🧘 Chill Mode: No timer; less penalties; just chill and pack stuff.

  • 📦 Normal Mode: Standard timer and penalties; intended progression. Good luck on your new job!

  • 🔥 Rush Hour Mode: You have less time to pack and more penalties for your mistakes. I hope they pay you well.

Thank you for reading, feel free to reach us on our Discord or Steam Community Forums if you have questions about the game. 💛

3500680.name: Cropdeck
3500680.detailed_description:
Plant, grow, and harvest in this cozy farming roguelite deckbuilder.

Clear your fields, plant crops strategically, and protect them from wild weather. Combine quirky scarecrows and their powerful passive effects to create satisfying combos. Build your deck of plants – and don’t forget to pay taxes, because Sir Landlord always comes for his share! All wrapped in a wholesome and charming package.

🌱 Plant, grow, and harvest!

  • Clear obstacles and plow to prepare your land for planting.

  • Strategically plan your crop layout for maximum efficiency and yields.

  • Nurture your plants – water, fertilize, and shield them from harm.

  • Reap your harvest and turn a profit, but watch out – Sir Landlord might drop by for his tax!

🎃 Find the best combos!

  • Uncover a variety of unique scarecrows with powerful perks and passives to supercharge your farming.

  • Experiment with different scarecrow combinations and create the ultimate synergy.

  • Build your deck around their abilities or hunt for the perfect ones to complete your collection. The possibilities are (almost) endless!

🔥 Outsmart challenges!

  • Facing thunder, droughts, tornadoes, or even ice cubes? There ain’t no rest for the farmer!

  • Brave diverse biomes and adapt to unique hazards in every scenario.

  • Protect your crops at all costs! Sir Landlord won’t wait - he’ll collect his tax rain or shine.

⚒️ Craft your ideal deck!

  • Earn gems by completing levels and use them at the market to expand your card collection.

  • Take a risk with themed card packs or stick to safer picks from the seller’s inventory.

  • Got a card you don’t need or a scarecrow that’s not working for you? Remove them and keep your deck streamlined.

  • Visit the forge, and upgrade your cards to the next level! Use copies to merge them.

3503710.name: Medieval Horse Dealer Simulator
3503710.detailed_description:
Once a respected baron, you lost everything when a trusted vassal betrayed your family and seized your title. Forced to flee across the sea with only a handful of coins, you take refuge in a remote land and purchase a rundown stable to begin a new life.

Trade horses, formulate feed, and breed generations of elite horses. Train and auction valuable stock, expand your stables, mine resources, forge weapons and armor, farm crops, run merchant caravans, recruit villagers, train mercenaries, and earn the favor of powerful lords. Build your fortune from the ground up and dominate the medieval horse trade.

When your forces are finally strong enough, return across the sea to confront the usurper, reclaim your birthright, and restore your family's honor.

1. Craft the Perfect Feed for Your Horses

Cut grass, plant crops on your farmland, and discover or invent advanced horse feed recipes to craft the perfect feed for your horses.

2. Care for Your Horses

Feed your horses and perform daily tasks to keep them comfortable, healthy, and in top condition.

3. Train Your Horses

Use a variety of training approaches to improve different aspects of your horses and make them stand out in the market.

4. Breed Elite Bloodlines

Breed foals across generations to improve growth and inherit powerful, positive traits. Discover, inherit, and combine epic horse bloodlines.

5. Establish Your Own Merchant Caravan

Prepare wagons, hire merchants, and equip them with horses to open trade routes between towns and earn high profits.

6. Run Your Own Blacksmith Shop

Mine ores, build your own blacksmith shop, upgrade equipment, uncover legendary blueprints, and craft high-quality items for your horses and mercenaries, or sell them to customers.

7. Build Your Own Mercenary Army

Hire villagers and train them into different troop types. Prepare weapons, armor, and horses, develop them from rookies into elite veterans, and accept contracts from nearby rulers and other clients.

8. Raise Livestock

Raise livestock, build shelters, and collect products such as milk and eggs. Care for newborn animals and sell livestock to local farmers.

9. Craft Valuable Goods

Produce cheese, brew beer, and craft other valuable goods to expand your business.

3527020.name: Shut the windows and don't look outside
3527020.detailed_description:
Gameplay

Survive:

You are alone, trapped in your own home, waiting for "help" to arrive. To make it through the night, you must keep your fear in check and ensure no unwelcome presence lingers for too long. Every second in the dark brings you closer to the unknown.

Manage:

Your home is your only refuge, but the power supply is limited. You must carefully ration your energy, deciding which rooms to keep lit and which to let fall into darkness. Every flicker of light could mean the difference between safety and exposure. Run out of fuel, and you may not get another chance.

Sanity:

Windows keep opening… but did you forget to close them, or is something else inside with you? Keep them shut at all costs. If you let them stay open too long, you might see something you were never meant to. And whatever happens—do not look outside.

Fear:

Fear is more than a feeling—it’s an invitation. If you let the terror take hold, It will take notice. Things that shouldn’t be there begin to manifest. If you see them, make them disappear quickly. Do not stare. Do not hesitate. If you let them stay, you may not be able to tell what’s real anymore.

Story


A critical notice from the Bureau of Liberty and Individual Safety (B.L.I.S.)

Recent disturbances and abnormal phenomena have been detected in your area. For your safety and well-being, all individuals must remain inside their homes. Under no circumstances should you look outside. Keep all doors locked and windows shut.

DO NOT LOOK OUTSIDE. DO NOT GO OUTSIDE.

Some citizens have reported symptoms due to extended isolation, including:

  • Dry mouth

  • Blurred Vision

  • Irregular heart rhythm

  • Elevated blood pressure

  • Paranoia

  • Sightings of Angels

These symptoms are normal and will worsen if instructions are not followed.

To minimize these symptoms:

  • Keep a well-lit environment

  • Ensure all windows remain shut

  • Avoid visual contact with the outside

  • Avoid visual contact with the Angels

B.L.I.S. thanks you for your cooperation. Re-read this message carefully.

3548580.name: Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story
3548580.detailed_description:
Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story is a work-focused sound novel game where you work at your desk alongside Satone, an imaginative girl who loves writing novels. Customize the Lofi music, ambient sounds, and scenery that reflect Satone’s emotions to enhance your focus! The more time you spend working together, the deeper your bond will grow—perhaps you’ll even connect with Satone on a deeper level…?

NEWS

We've added macOS support — thanks to your many requests! (May 13, 2025)

Emotionally Expressive Music to Maximize Focus

Whether you want to relax and work at a leisurely pace or boost your motivation with emotionally engaging melodies, Chill Talk offers a variety of original songs tailored for different work scenarios.
Immerse yourself in deep focus while listening to high-quality music from talented sound artists.

A Wide Variety of Nature Sounds to Awaken Your Instincts

Sometimes, it’s best to turn off the music and listen to the soothing sounds of nature. Let the sound of wind, rain, and other natural elements sharpen your senses and create a deeply immersive work environment.
Customize the ambient sounds to suit your preferences.

Pomodoro Timer for Maximum Productivity

Set up a Pomodoro timer before you start working to manage your break times effectively. Taking short, regular breaks helps maintain maximum concentration and efficiency.

Satone’s Hidden Feelings

During your break, take time to interact with Satone. The “precious moments” you share while working together will deepen your relationship, and if you build enough trust, she may eventually open her heart to you.

3552140.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
3552140.detailed_description:
Relive the golden ages of video rentals by opening your very own video store. Rent, sell, organize and build your business from the ground up. Hire staff, manage your team and become the best rental destination in town!

  

 

From taking reservations and charging late fees to recommending movies and preparing delicious snacks, there’s never a dull moment when running your store!

 

 

Customize your walls and floors, decorate with posters and memorabilia and expand your layout to build the video store of your dreams.

 

 

Fill your shelves with thousands of unique VHS tapes, each with their own title, genre and hand-drawn cover art! Order movies on your old PC or buy exclusive bootleg films from the shady Tape Dealer. Each week will have new releases inspired by real iconic movies of the 80s and early 90s.  

 

 

Additional Game Features:

  • Build Your Dream Team: Hire staff to give you a hand on daily tasks to run your store.

  • Manage Your Returns:  Add returned movies in the system, rewind tapes and set aside reserved movies for your customers.

  • Charge Late & Broken Fees: Track late and damaged returns and deal with different customer reactions and complaints.

  • Evolving Customer Interactions: Seasons, weather and holidays affect gameplay and what your customers rent! Be ready, rainy Friday nights are crazy busy in the store!

  • Seasons & Festivals: Play through all four seasons as the environment transforms around you. Each season features special holidays and festivals, all brought to life with unique artwork!

  • Share Movies With Your Friends: Every movie can be ordered on your PC with a unique code that you can share with your friends!

3558600.name: Leafy Corner
3558600.detailed_description:
Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES

  • Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.

  • Discover plant variegations.

  • Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.

  • Fulfill orders and help customers.

  • Complete tasks to progress your shop.

  • Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.

  • Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:

  • Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).

  • Advanced plant care.

  • Storyline.

We are working hard and pouring our hearts into making Leafy Corner. You can support us by wishlisting and following the game on Steam. And if you want to chat with us or fellow plant lovers, you can find us on Discord!

3582250.name: Farm to Table
3582250.detailed_description:
Farm to Table is a farming and restaurant management sim where you build a restaurant from scratch and grow food in the backyard. Explore a colourful island where you can grow and gather food, raise animals, go fishing, produce better food with machines and cook delicious recipes for your hungry guests! Build and customise your dream place, hire staff and grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant! 

Build From Scratch

Build your restaurant from scratch on a coastal hill overlooking a colorful island! Customize each corner of your kitchen and farm, indoors or outdoors. Choose from a wide variety of wall, flooring, window, decoration, and furniture styles.

Grow, Raise & Harvest

Grow fresh crops and raise animals right by your kitchen! Collect fresh produce and adopt pet companions. One harvest at a time!

Cook & Serve

Cook and Serve or Sell at your Farmers’ Market. Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island! Create diverse menus, cook, bake, grill and serve flavoursome dishes to raise your reputation and attract even more customers!

Gather & Fish

Gather all kinds of wild flavours like mushrooms, berries and much more or go fishing in the open seas for rare catches!

Produce

Get useful machines to turn harvest into more advanced ingredients and unlock new recipes.

Manage 

Manage resources, hire chefs, waiters and farmers, upgrade and grow the reputation of your place.Take it slow on the farm, then pick up the pace in the kitchen, turn your cozy humble spot into a 5-star restaurant!

3614130.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
3614130.detailed_description:
Shelves And Sorcery is a relaxing fantasy organization game about turning absolute chaos back into order.

Weapons, potions, spellbooks, fruits, vegetables, magical curiosities, and thousands of other items have been scattered throughout three fantasy shops. Pick everything up, find where it belongs, and slowly watch each shop return to the way it was meant to be.

Take your time and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in its place, or learn every corner of the shop and race against players around the world for the fastest time.

Three Shops to Restore. Four Ways to Play.

Choose from three shops of dramatically different sizes, each with its own setting, atmosphere, and challenge. Then return to them in four different modes, whether you want to relax, chase the fastest time, wield every bit of magic from the start, or organize without magic at all.

• Casual Mode – No timer and no pressure. Take your time, enjoy the atmosphere, and organize every shelf at your own pace.

• Timed Mode – Race against the clock and compete on the global leaderboards. Learn where every item belongs, master your Sorceries and Enchantments, perfect your route, and keep pushing for a faster time.

• Archmage Mode – Start with every Sorcery and Enchantment already unlocked. Take on the entire shop at full magical strength and see just how powerful an experienced shopkeeper can be.

• No Magic Mode – The magic of the world has escaped. No Sorceries. No Enchantments. No magical shortcuts. Just you, thousands of misplaced items, and the knowledge you've gained along the way.

The Hearth & Barrel

3615160.name: Teddy's Haven
3615160.detailed_description:
Welcome to Teddy’s Haven. 

Welcome to a cozy, magical shop simulator set on the enchanting island of Ursa. Run your store your way and sell what you harvest, craft, or discover. And enjoy the freedom to decorate freely across your shop, home, and the wilds beyond.

Level up naturally as you play, grow magical crops, and take part in daily events that bring the island to life. With over 250 decorations, 400 items to sell, and no pressure, every day is yours to enjoy at your own pace.

Ursa, A World of Calm and Wonder

Ursa is a gentle land filled with peace, memories, and mythical spirits. Your shop is a safe haven of supplies for travelers and magical beings alike. The land is rich and vibrant. You can harvest resources, care for its creatures, and meet friendly creatures along the way. In Ursa there is no conflict, only warmth and calm. This is your relaxing world to make your own.

Key Features:

  • Manage Your Magical Shop – Create the cozy shop you’ve always wanted. With changing seasons, daily surprises, and rewarding leveling systems, your shop grows alongside you. No rush, no stress, just a magical rhythm all your own.

  • Decorate Across Ursa – Over 250 decorations to decorate freely across your shop, home, and the island’s landscapes. With near-limitless placement freedom, express your style and bring every corner of Ursa to life.

  • A Wide Variety of Goods to Keep Your Shelves Full – Stock your shop with over 400 items gathered, grown, or traded across Ursa.

  • Skill Systems – Your skills grow naturally as you run your shop. Stock shelves faster, harvest more berries, and see your abilities improve with each task. Leveling up rewards you for doing what you love, at your own pace.

  • Crafting – Enjoy simple, stress-free crafting that doesn’t keep you waiting. Place your items and return the next day to find something special created. Always growing, crafting will expand with new features and more complex options in future updates.

  • Farming – Farming has arrived in the land of Ursa! Unlock new contracts that allow you to plant and nurture magical crops, each with unique Aether-infused variations. Grow, harvest, and fill your shop with wondrous goods born from the earth and touched by magic.

  • Unique and Magical Employees – Hire magical stockers and cashiers who keep your shop running smoothly. Whether you’re decorating, relaxing, or out exploring the world, they’ll reliably care for your haven as if it were their own.

  • Simplified Inventory Management – Too busy to sort through a warehouse of items? Open your “bag of everything” and stock shelves directly, hassle-free. Spend less time managing and more time enjoying your shop.

  • Exploration – Wander the ever-expanding world of Ursa at your own pace. Harvest berries, care for animals, or simply enjoy the beautiful scenery and discover the magic hidden in every corner.

  • Daily Events – Your shop is a hub of life and wonder. As the days pass, creatures will stop by with stories, gifts, or even magical blessings for your shop. Everyone you meet is here to help you grow and enjoy your cozy world.

  • Bounds Breaking Joy: Teddy’s Haven celebrates curiosity. And sometimes that means climbing too high, falling too far, or finding yourself under the map. Go ahead: break the bounds. Secret items and small surprises await those who wander a little too far from the intended path. It’s all part of the adventure.

  • Auto Saving – Take the game at your own pace, no more requirements of ending your day for your game to be saved.

  • Ongoing Development: Teddy’s Haven is in Early Access, with plans for new locations, minigames, world events, and more, the journey has only just begun.

Created In Loving Dedication To The Memory Of My Best Friend Teddy Bear.

3618030.name: Flock Around
3618030.detailed_description:
Flock Around is a co-op birdwatching game where you explore a nature sanctuary. Solo or with friends, snap pictures of funny birds, and fill out the park guide book!

Snap them all!

Goose Lake Sanctuary is home to numerous bird species, and if you can see it, you can take a picture of it. Fill out the guide book with pictures of each bird in its various poses, from the common Robin, to more rare and exotic birds. Explore a variety of biomes, perform actions and use items to lure in species, and mess with your friends!

Flock Together!

Flock Around is designed to be a shared social space where you and your friends can work together to get pictures of birds or each other! Birding is best with others, so you can play with up to 10 friends!

Customize your birder!

Collect cosmetics and make your birder unique, expressing your personality and eagle eyes to your friends. After taking your pictures, develop them for money to spend on outfits so you can go birding in style!

3636770.name: Servant of the Lake
3636770.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Vanderboom house, home to the infamous Vanderboom family! Visitors are arriving soon, and you are meant to start your housekeeping duties immediately!

Solve the puzzles needed to fulfil your daily tasks, look after the household, welcome the visitor and ensure their comfort while helping the family achieve their alchemical ambitions!

Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

Features:

  • Going back to our Roots -  Servant of the Lake is a classic single-player Rusty Lake point-and-click adventure set in the infamous Vanderboom house during the era of Aldous and William Vanderboom.

  • Solve surreal puzzles – Expect to go from simple tasks such as straightening the family portraits and doing the laundry to assisting in complex experiments and cleaning up the aftermath.

  • Unravel a dark narrative – Live through events set decades before Rusty Lake: Roots! As the servant of the Vanderboom estate, you can explore each room of The House while making sure the family is looked after. Do you think you can survive the weekend?

  • Immersive soundtrack - Haunting melodies composed and performed by Victor Butzelaar to keep you company while puzzling your way through your daily, usual and unusual tasks.

3643170.name: Roadside Research
3643170.detailed_description:
2026 Roadmap for Early Access


About the Game

Aliens have landed on Earth… to run a gas station. Play solo or up to 4 players and do human tasks to blend in. People depend on you, it’s your job to make sure that the shelves have the correct items, refuel customers passing by, and provide food for travelers. But most importantly, you must conduct your research.

Stay Undetected 

Your mission is simple. Gather all data you can from humans without their knowledge. Scan, steal, and test various methods on customers while they stop by the gas station. Be careful not to raise the “suspicion meter” too high, as that will trigger the visit of government officials.

Be Normal, Be Human 

During the day, take care of the gas station as an ordinary employee. Restock the shelves, order wares for the shop, refuel passersby, and exchange goods for cash. At night you will be able to gather your thoughts, and plan for the next day. 

Upgrade and Customize 

Balance between two missions, upgrading the gas station to attract more customers and upgrading your alien tech to process data and gather information more efficiently. To blend in, draw a very normal human expression on your state-of-the-art disguise.

During closing hours, you can also upgrade the station, inside and outside to make sure everything is going according to plan.

Features

  • Chaotic solo or co-op fun: Gather friends or play alone to manage the gas station while pursuing your alien mission.

  • Dual Upgrade Path: Manage upgrades for your gas station and for your alien technology at the same time

  • Satisfying Simulation: Clean, cook, and stock your workplace with all necessary supplies and items to make sure every customer leaves satisfied.

  • Alien Deception: Make sure to stay disguised and don’t get caught by human government officials. If you are too suspicious, they will turn you into goo.

3656800.name: Train Sim World® 6
3656800.detailed_description:
Embark on your next journey and discover the joy of train simulation. Be ready for anything as you master formidable trains across 3 new routes; from classic equipment to innovative multiple units, unlock new skills and expand your hobby - Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6!

ALL ABOARD FOR HOBOKEN

Discover the electrified network of NJ TRANSIT® with the MORRISTOWN LINE. March across the Morris & Essex County suburbs and dart between the Big Apple and the commuter town of Dover aboard the classic Arrow III EMU, or the ALP-46 & MultiLevel cars.

DELUXE EDITION: Power up prime movers or position the pantograph, take control of the versatile NJ TRANSIT® ALP-45DP on additional and bustling commuter services.

THE ENGLISH RIVIERA

Dive down the Devon Banks and soar along the Dawlish Sea Wall with the legendary RIVIERA LINE. Drive GWR services bound for idyllic English coastal towns between Exeter, Plymouth & Paignton aboard the “Intercity” Class 802 and Class 150/2 “Sprinter”.

DELUXE EDITION: Go on a long-distance voyage in the CROSSCOUNTRY BR CLASS 220. Drive additional services over the hills to Plymouth & Paignton.

NEXT STOP: LEIPZIG

Go beyond the boundaries of Nahverkehr Dresden and accelerate westbound all the way to Leipzig in BAHNSTRECKE LEIPZIG - DRESDEN. Drive modern ICE-T, BR 442 and loco-hauled passenger trains, as well as freight, along the oldest long-distance railway in Germany.

DELUXE EDITION: Venerable shunting traction drives into the yards of Germany; the iconic DB BR 294 is ready for service! Assemble trains and take them across the mainline with classic diesel power.

EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED

The next station is… ANNOUNCEMENTS! Listen out both on platforms & trains for audible details of every journey. Be further immersed inside trains with added passenger ambience. Be ready for RANDOM EVENTS & FAULTS, signals may take longer to clear, speed restrictions could be in place, or equipment failures on your train may need resolving.

THE RAILS ARE YOURS

With a diverse array of features such as Photo Mode, Route Hopping and more, embark on your own journey, in your own way.

FREE ROAM: Choose your path and explore any route with your favourite trains! Have the rails entirely to yourself or mix in with the timetable, running between scheduled services on your own ad hoc journeys.

CONDUCTOR MODE: Tickets please! Enjoy a different pace on conductor-operated trains - check tickets between each station and work the passenger doors to safely dispatch your service. Take a moment to enjoy the scenery on longer stretches between stations.

CREATORS CLUB: Get creative and customise your experience! Use LIVERY DESIGNER to make your dream designs come to life, and FORMATION DESIGNER to make up custom trains using your collection. Put creations to use with Free Roam & SCENARIO PLANNER, or share your creations online! (Dovetail Live sign-up required).

YOUR COLLECTION, YOUR WAY

Enter the hobby with different editions:

FREE STARTER PACK introduces you to Train Sim World 6 with the Training Center.

STANDARD EDITION comes with the 3 new routes, DELUXE EDITION also comes with additional new trains, and SPECIAL EDITION comes with an additional set of TSW6 Compatible routes.

“TSW Compatible” content released for a previous Train Sim World - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features.

Kick-start your railway hobby with everyone’s favourite Tank Engine. Train Sim World 6: Thomas & Friends™ Edition gives you everything you need to enjoy the Thomas & Friends™ Visit the West Somerset Railway add-on and 80th Anniversary Expansion - drive beloved characters in story-based adventures!

Look forward to a great variety of experiences from multiple countries. Explore the many existing routes and locos and get ready for new challenges as the world of train simulation ever expands.

With any upgrades from a previous Train Sim World – your content comes with you!

Please Note: The Train Sim World 6 UI is localised into English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. Localisation on Add-On content varies depending on the individual content.

Go beyond the boundaries of Nahverkehr Dresden and accelerate westbound all the way to Leipzig in BAHNSTRECKE LEIPZIG - DRESDEN. Drive modern ICE-T, BR 442 and loco-hauled passenger trains, as well as freight, along the oldest long-distance railway in Germany.

DELUXE EDITION: Venerable shunting traction drives into the yards of Germany; the iconic DB BR 294 is ready for service! Assemble trains and take them across the mainline with classic diesel power.

EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED

The next station is… ANNOUNCEMENTS! Listen out both on platforms & trains for audible details of every journey. Be further immersed inside trains with added passenger ambience. Be ready for RANDOM EVENTS & FAULTS, signals may take longer to clear, speed restrictions could be in place, or equipment failures on your train may need resolving.

THE RAILS ARE YOURS

With a diverse array of features such as Photo Mode, Route Hopping and more, embark on your own journey, in your own way.

FREE ROAM: Choose your path and explore any route with your favourite trains! Have the rails entirely to yourself or mix in with the timetable, running between scheduled services on your own ad hoc journeys.

CONDUCTOR MODE: Tickets please! Enjoy a different pace on conductor-operated trains - check tickets between each station and work the passenger doors to safely dispatch your service. Take a moment to enjoy the scenery on longer stretches between stations.

CREATORS CLUB: Get creative and customise your experience! Use LIVERY DESIGNER to make your dream designs come to life, and FORMATION DESIGNER to make up custom trains using your collection. Put creations to use with Free Roam & SCENARIO PLANNER, or share your creations online! (Dovetail Live sign-up required).

YOUR COLLECTION, YOUR WAY

Enter the hobby with different editions:

FREE STARTER PACK introduces you to Train Sim World 6 with the Training Center.

STANDARD EDITION comes with the 3 new routes, DELUXE EDITION also comes with additional new trains, and SPECIAL EDITION comes with an additional set of TSW6 Compatible routes.

“TSW Compatible” content released for a previous Train Sim World - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features.

Kick-start your railway hobby with everyone’s favourite Tank Engine. Train Sim World 6: Thomas & Friends™ Edition gives you everything you need to enjoy the Thomas & Friends™ Visit the West Somerset Railway add-on and 80th Anniversary Expansion - drive beloved characters in story-based adventures!

Look forward to a great variety of experiences from multiple countries. Explore the many existing routes and locos and get ready for new challenges as the world of train simulation ever expands.

With any upgrades from a previous Train Sim World – your content comes with you!

Please Note: The Train Sim World 6 UI is localised into English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. Localisation on Add-On content varies depending on the individual content.
