3659410.name: Your Big, Cute Monster Farm
3659410.detailed_description:
Welcome to join us now!


About the Game

"Your Big, Cute Monster Farm" is a casual idle farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. With no complex controls required, your cute monsters will handle all the farming — from tilling and planting to watering and harvesting. A lively little world quietly grows. Just take a moment to arrange your facilities while you work or study, decorate your farm, and enjoy the fruits of your labor!

Each monster has a special skill: some are great at planting, others at watering, some excel at harvesting. There are even rare all-rounder critters who can do it all! Just assign your monsters to the right plots, and they’ll spring into work automatically. Occasionally ring the little bell to urge them on and make your farm even more efficient!

As your farm grows, your initial team of monsters won’t be enough to handle the increasing workload. You’ll need more powerful partners to join your farming team. Use hatchery to hatch brand-new monsters and enjoy the thrill of upgrades. Or try the merge system to transfer one monster’s ability to another. Keep optimizing your monsters through hatching, training, and merging to build the ultimate monster farming team!

There are dozens of crop types in the game that unlock as you progress. But don’t underestimate the ordinary ones — they may surprise you! A regular cabbage might mutate into a rose-cabbage, and a cauliflower could grow cute cat ears suddenly. These mutated crops aren’t just visually unique and delightfully surprising — they also sell for a higher price! It’s truly a case of “double the harvest for the same effort!”

As you continue playing, you’ll unlock a variety of adorable decorations and functional buildings: wooden fences, flower beds, water wells — everything you need! Drag and drop things anywhere you like to create the farm of your dreams. Watching your custom farm come to life is endlessly satisfying. And as the map expands, you’ll uncover ancient ruins, uniquely themed regions, and more surprises just waiting to be discovered.

3670630.name: Besmirch
3670630.detailed_description:
Roadmap

Roadmap is written as of May 2026 and is subject to change.

Priority will be given to areas players would like to see worked on first.


About the Game

You've been hired to work a farm in the isolated town of Besmirch. The land is failing, the people are frightened, and the Baron’s tithe grows heavier by the day. Whispers of an apocalypse drift between shuttered windows, and every night unholy monstrosities move beyond the fields. Your task is as simple as it is impossible: keep the town alive long enough to save it.

As the latest farmhand, you’ll coax crops from barren earth, cook what little you can, and fight tooth and nail to protect every sapling. Each seed struggles to grow, and each harvest is a hard-won victory. Keep a pittance for yourself and share what you can with a town desperate for relief, while still surrendering the Baron’s due. This cursed farm is your lifeline, your burden, and your battleground.

Besmirch’s outskirts are riddled with hidden places, buried secrets, forgotten sins. Brave the Baron's crumbling Mansion; scavenging what you can from its haunted depths. Explore while daylight lasts, for when night comes, demons awake. You must hurry home, seal the doors, and pray your faith does not fail you.

The people of Besmirch pass judgement by omens as much as deeds, and their blessings turn to curses when hunger rises. To stay in their good graces, you must walk carefully between superstition, devotion, and the secrets they refuse to share. With their perception poisoned by desperation, you must prove you are worth more alive than banished.

Xbox Controller support. Mouse and Keyboard may be needed occasionally.

3683770.name: Boba Cafe Simulator
3683770.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Please add "Boba Cafe Simulator" to your wish list and follow us! This will be very helpful to us!

Run a milk tea shop with up to 8 players in co-op. Craft drinks by hand, design menus and prices, place equipment, decorate your shop, handle customer flow and delivery platforms—and build your ultimate milk tea empire.

Have you ever dreamed of owning your milk tea shop? 

In Boba Cafe Simulator – Reborn as the Manager of Bingbao, you and your friends become business partners, embarking on a cozy yet strategic management adventure.

Play solo or co-op with up to 8 players.

Join from the lobby, communicate via voice and text chat, and work together online.

Start a brand-new shop with friends—or take full control and run everything on your own in single-player mode.

Friendship and teamwork will all be put to the test.
Will you work together to grow the business—or create chaos and sabotage each other?
The choice is yours.

From signature lemonade, fresh orange tea, and classic bubble milk tea, to coffee and seasonal special drinks—every step is hands-on.

Cut fruit, brew tea, cook tapioca pearls, grind coffee beans, add ice and syrup…
Every cup is crafted by you.

Keep your fridge stocked, unlock 100+ of recipes, and in the future, add your dream drinks via Workshop support.

Customize your menu and pricing freely.
Low prices and high volume?
Premium drinks with high margins?
It’s your shop—but the market will react differently to every decision.

It’s 2077—of course your milk tea shop has delivery.
Choose between multiple delivery platforms, balancing contract fees, revenue splits, and traffic.

Recruit Fred as an employee to help run your shop—he can work the register or deliver orders for you.

Or in co-op mode, ask make your friends handle deliveries and drink-making to save on wages and rider fees.

Do whatever it takes to manage your milk tea business.

New drinks are introduced based on various holidays.
11 real weather types directly affect customer preferences.

Who wouldn’t want a hot cocoa in winter—or an ice-cold watermelon juice in summer?
Enjoy limited-time drinks for Spring Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, Lantern Festival, Halloween, Christmas, and more.

Explore night-only shops, rare items, magical potions, and mysterious goods.
A milk tea shop owner who doesn’t know alchemy isn’t a good wizard.

Serve mysterious customers at night—something good might happen.

Name your shop anything you like—from “Mixxue” to “Gang Cha” or “CaCa”.

As you level up, expand your business into a city landmark flagship store.

Design your layout freely.
From shelves, counters, and digital signs to wallpapers, lamps, and even bedding—everything can be placed, rotated, and adjusted.

Decorate your shop, boost popularity, and turn it into a must-visit destination.

You can even change your in-game phone wallpaper.
Workshop support for custom decorations is planned for the future.

Build the milk tea shop of your dreams.

Enjoy side activities like farming, fishing, and pet companions.

Grow ingredients in the morning, decide where every tea leaf goes,
or fish at night after closing, clearing your mind and planning tomorrow’s strategy.

Go outside, socialize with neighbors, build relationships, and unlock exclusive recipes or furniture blueprints.
Kindness is always rewarded.

Tired of unreasonable negative reviews?
No need to hold back—knock the troublemaker out cold and help them “sleep peacefully,”
improving their sleep quality and becoming a responsible citizen.

"With the warmth of one cup of tea, save a universe on the brink of sweet collapse."

Click [Open for Business] now—Icebao's tail is already spinning like a propeller! 🧊🌀

3683770.reviews:
“There are plenty of small studios not taking the scorched earth approach, such as…… Boba Cafe Simulator's Caikemi. There is genuine demand for games like this, and evidence of studios putting a lot of love and effort in. - Shaun Prescott”
PC gamer

“Boba Cafe Simulator adds its own two pearls and pint of condensed milk to a pot that is rather bloated with sugar-coated ingredients of a similar taste. That said, as it brings a multiplayer element to the cauldron, it does make for one of the better, more appealing games of its kind. Oh, it’s still a business simulation game with generic chore core gameplay, but it’s also a good alternative for your traditional solo endeavor. If not for its co-op mode, it would probably fall to the back of the line as yet another word-for-word sim. But, I can vouch for its entertainment value. You just need the right sous chefs to make your money’s worth. - Jord Tury”
8/10 – GAMING

“A charming second-chance tale that nails the cozy business sim formula with genuine depth and strategic management gameplay. That’s our TBB Curator take, and after a ninety-minute demo session we didn’t want to end, it holds up. Boba Cafe Simulator looks like a casual milk-tea game and quietly turns into a satisfying logistics puzzle wrapped in one of the most charming premises we’ve seen this year. The honest split: if you love cozy management sims, or you’ve got friends for the 8-player co-op, this is an easy one to grab at launch — especially with 35% off the first week bringing it well under eleven dollars. The chaos of a full crew splitting drink-making, deliveries, and the register is exactly what this game is built for. - Obsidian”
8/10 – The Big Bois

3688130.detailed_description:
Roadmap


WORKS GREAT ON STEAM DECK


About the Game

TURN GRIME INTO SHINE - AT YOUR OWN PACE

Open the door to a long-forgotten fridge and become a true sanitation hero! In this chilli mold-cleaning arcade, you control a guy (nigiri?!) with a pressure stream to clean off mold that has taken over food, shelves, drawers and even the freezer.

FEATURES:

  • Pressure-Powered Gameplay - Aim, spray, and switch cleaning modes. Blast away different types of dirt while getting a huge sense of satisfaction from cleaning. Let's be honest, it's the only kitchen you'll ever get sparkling clean.

  • Choose the Best Tool – Wield a pressure washer, leaf blower, flamethrower, pickaxe, and more to tackle stubborn grime across the kitchen. Adapt your approach (full berserk is okay too) and level up each tool to boost your skills and make your gear even more powerful!

  • Varied Locations - Every corner of the kitchen — from the shelf in the fridge, to those odd boxes, the forgotten nooks behind the freezer, or the kitchen countertop - every corner hides something to scrub. Make your kitchen shine and peek behind jars in the fridge — you never know what you can find there!

  • Strange & Sticky Foes - How gross is it to talk about different kinds of dirt? Just clean it up, pls.

  • Adorable Food Hero -  You're the Nigiri. Cute sushi on a mission to clean everything!

  • Progression & Unlocks – Earn new audio tracks, and cosmetic items to personalize your basement. Cash in your points for shinier and stronger gear at the store—because clean heroes deserves style.

  • Lo-Fi Beats - A chill lo-fi tracks and satisfying cleaning sounds make every spray extremely calming.

3690030.name: The Last Gas Station
3690030.detailed_description:
Roadmap

We are continuing to actively work on the game - patches and updates will keep improving The Last Gas Station. Thanks to you, this cozy little shop is becoming even better! 


About the Game

You are the new owner of an old gas station and a cozy little store next to it. The previous owner disappeared under mysterious circumstances, and now it is your turn to maintain order here.

Grow your business: clear out the trash, organize the space, set up trade, order goods, set prices, work the cash register and monitor the fuel levels. Turn the old ruin into a beacon for travelers stuck in time!

But no matter what happens, do not go out at night unless you want to share the fate of the previous owner.

MODERNIZE THE GAS STATION

Get rid of the old equipment and order new things. Expand the list of services provided: install a tire pumping machine and outfit an area for oil changes and maintenance. Arrange gasoline supplies and customize your neon sign so the station will be noticed even on the darkest of nights.

SET UP YOUR STORE

Fix up your gas station store and turn it into a stable source of income. Buy shelves, fridges and equipment, improve the retail space and customize it to fit your style. Expand the building, increase the range of products and optimize the layout to serve more customers and earn money faster.

ESTABLISH TRADE AND SERVE CUSTOMERS

Stock shelves and fridges with snacks, drinks and dozens of useful road trip items and car supplies. Set your prices and make profit to buy new upgrades. Don't forget to serve customers at the checkout on time- let happy clients spread the word that the old gas station is back in business.

DO NOT GO OUT AT NIGHT

They say it's best not to go out here at night. The previous owner didn't listen... and no one has seen him since.

3693650.name: Thrifty Business
3693650.detailed_description:
There’s a brand new thrift store in town, and guess what? You’re in charge!

In Thrifty Business, you’ll set up and manage your very own 90’s-inspired vintage thrift shop. Search through boxes filled with pre-loved gems and use them to create gorgeous displays. Unlock furniture, decorations, wallpaper & floors to create a beautiful community space that brings everybody together!

Adjust your layout and organize your shelves and racks to the finest detail. Group your wares by colour, theme, purpose, or whatever you like. The more organized your store is, the more community points you’ll get to unlock new goodies!

Customize the furniture, wallpaper, flooring and decor to make your store as welcoming and cozy as possible. As business grows, you might even need to expand into the adjacent rooms!

This is so much more than just a store. Listen to customer’s stories and try to fulfill their requests. You can also unlock and host hobbyist events, turning your business into a treasured third space for locals!


🛍️ What Thrifty Business has in store for you:

  • laid-back management sim

  • colorful 90s-inspired graphics

  • 500+ different items to add to your shelves

  • precision placing so you can organize exactly how you want

  • customization options: furniture, decorations, wallpaper & flooring

  • a quirky and unique cast of customers

🙅‍♀️ What you won’t find on our shelves:

  • stressful min-maxing to get the best possible profit

  • setting item prices or haggling

  • impatient customers that leave your store in anger

3712080.name: Funnel Runners
3712080.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Welcome to Funnel Runners, where you will have your first on-site deployment with APEX Storm Monitoring Services.

A high-priority F5 tornado is approaching, and we are counting on you (and up to 7 fellow friends) to collect data, scavenge necessary information, and, of course, survive.

The weather is your worst enemy here. Tornados and storms will spawn randomly, grow stronger over time, and tear the whole map apart. Buildings will collapse piece by piece, and items will no longer be found in destroyed areas, so you must adapt quickly.  Be careful not to be swept up by the wind; you may not be found again.

In this mission, you can team up with 7 other players or tackle it solo. Share gadgets, split up to cover more ground, collect necessary information and items to fix the van before the situation turns bad.

With realistic graphics and a first-person perspective, the experience brings you close to every gust of wind, distant siren, and falling piece of debris.

Scavenge the collapsing city for scattered vehicle parts, fuel, and tools. These items will allow you to repair your van and help you survive the storm. Each playthrough features randomized environments, weather, items, and problems to solve on your vehicle. No playthrough will be the same.

3715020.name: Ye Guild Clerk!
3715020.detailed_description:
Ye Guild Clerk! is a short 2.5D, interactive narrative game, where you play as a newly hired guild clerk in a world full of cute animal adventurers! Perfect for players who love character-driven stories, cute animals, and cozy medieval fantasy worlds.

Features

  • Meet a cast of cute animal adventurers, each with their own stories and quirks!

  • Have 5 days to prove you're a good fit for the role!.. or suffer the consequences and get fired...

  • As a guild clerk, you'll hand out quests, rewards and equipment!... But be wary:

    • Your choices matter, each action you take shapes the outcomes and stories for each adventurer you run into... for better or for worse!

  • Over 40+ individual endings between all of the adventurers you can meet!

  • Decorate your clerk booth with various customizations and decorations! 

  • Select from 3 different music tracks to listen to!

Controls:

  • Point & Click Controls - Drag, Select, & Camera Movement

  • WASD/Arrow Keys - Camera Movement

  • Click/Space - Continue Dialogue

  • ESC - Pause/Settings Menu

Please Note:
There is no current way to save your progress. It is highly recommended to play in one sitting. The average playthrough can take from 35 - 50 minutes.

3729550.name: Stackmon
3729550.detailed_description:
Stackmon is a creature-collecting adventure with a unique card-stacking twist. Discover and capture new creatures and stack them with resource and equipment cards to unlock even rarer items and effects. Build up your camp, explore a vibrant world, and take on rival Scout Leaders, as you uncover the dark mystery behind the Soot – a strange corruption spreading across the land.

Features

-          Discover 100+ Stackmon including Evolutions, Rare and Legendary editions!

-          25+ different Buildings to construct and upgrade your home base

-          20+ Equipment and Item cards to buff your Stackmon and Scouts

-          7 unique biomes to explore, each with their own game altering mechanics

Drag and drop Stackmon, resources and items onto each other to form powerful combinations! Use your Stackmon to gather materials, craft items, automate tasks and battle other Stackmon. Grow and customize your Harmony base to unlock new recipes, upgrades, and abilities for your Stackmon.

Discover and collect over 100 rare and powerful Stackmon and train and evolve them into their more powerful forms. Search for wild Stackmon across the world of Gaia, open booster packs to expand your collection, and help Professor Pine in his dream of completing the Stackpedia!

Venture beyond your base and challenge other Scouts scattered across the world to prove your strength and rise your way through the ranks. Take on rival Scouts in strategic auto-battles, using equipment, abilities and elemental affinities to your advantage. Face off against powerful Scout Leaders and show the strength of Harmony!

A mysterious and dangerous force is spreading throughout Gaia, corrupting any Stackmon and Scout Leaders in its path... It's up to you and your Stackmon to find the source of the corruption, face the Soot and change the fate that approaches.

• Strange events are affecting the village, and it’s up to you to uncover the truth. Complete quests, meet mysterious characters, and restore harmony as the story unfolds.

• Get to know the charming residents of Pebble Town, each with their own stories, quirks, and secrets. Strengthen your bonds through heartfelt conversations and meaningful interactions.

3767740.name: Outhold
3767740.detailed_description:
Outhold is a tower defense game with incremental-style meta-progression. It's intended to be a short and compact experience, offering around 4-5 hours of gameplay across 10 levels, with some additional endgame content for those who like min/maxing builds.

Addictive game loop

Start a run, see how far you get. Use your collected resources to buy upgrades and try again. Become powerful enough to obliterate everything coming against you. 

Deep upgrade tree

Create unique builds that fit your playstyle. Experimentation is rewarded, and all upgrades can be refunded for free.

Strategize

Focus on upgrading just one specific tower, or find unique tower synergies. There are many ways to progress through Outhold, the choice is up to you.

3767850.name: SpiritVale
3767850.detailed_description:
Embark on an epic journey in SpiritVale, a class-based action MMORPG inspired by the classics, explore the world and fight more than 230 Monsters as well as 20+ World Bosses. Level up your character, find the best build for your class and enjoy the wonders of Nevaris!

Add SpiritVale to your wishlist — join us and start your own adventure!

Explore this world with more than 30 maps filled with unique biomes, diverse monsters, boss fights and players in every corner. From Meadows to Underwater Adventures, each biome delivers fresh discoveries and bold challenges. Discover more about this massive world as you immerse yourself in a new journey.

Explore different gameplay styles with 7 Base Classes: Acolyte, Mage, Summoner, Knight, Warrior, Scout or Rogue. Unlock unique skill trees and advanced specializations as you grow.

Advanced Specializations: Priest, Wizard, Necromancer, Paladin, Berserker, Gunslinger, Shinobi and Weaver.

Create your own unique characters using customization as well as an almost limitless number of cosmetic options! Defeat enemies to earn a variety of loot, including weapons, armor, pets, and exclusive items. Customize your character's appearance and gear to showcase your style.

Collect tons of cards, equipment, armor sets, gems and much more! Build your character the way you want, with hundreds of possibilities. Choose from more than 430 types of equipment to be the most powerful!

Cards and Artifacts are 2 important features in SpiritVale, both allow you to build your character the way you want or need for specific content! With more than 220 cards and 33 Artifact Sets, you can freely mix and match to adapt to any build or biome.

Collect valuable items, obtain raw materials and make new tools. Upgrade your equipment to strengthen your character and challenge powerful enemies.

Earn, trade, and manage your own inventory. Get powerful gear from boss drops and player-to-player trading. Place your vending stall, compare other players prices and compete with thousands of players in one shared economy.

PvP Combat: PvP battles in the Arena. Fight against players or even your friends. Participate in events, where your skill and strategy will determine victory.

PvE Combat: Many challenges await as you fight a variety of monsters. Earn experience and valuable loot as you fight through a slew of diverse enemies.

Join The Community

The community is our most important aspect. We strive to maintain a strong, engaged community, supporting our players. You're not just playing; you are helping build SpiritVale. The developer is active in our chat channels and has been constantly listening to feedback to improve SpiritVale everyday. SpiritVale is still in active development with updates being made on a weekly and even daily basis.

Fair-To-Play. Never Pay-To-Win.

We're committed to creating a fair playing field for all players. All Microtransactions in SpiritVale are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay.

Collect tons of cards, equipment, armor sets, gems and much more! Build your character the way you want, with hundreds of possibilities. Choose from more than 430 types of equipment to be the most powerful!

Cards and Artifacts are 2 important features in SpiritVale, both allow you to build your character the way you want or need for specific content! With more than 220 cards and 33 Artifact Sets, you can freely mix and match to adapt to any build or biome.

Collect valuable items, obtain raw materials and make new tools. Upgrade your equipment to strengthen your character and challenge powerful enemies.

Earn, trade, and manage your own inventory. Get powerful gear from boss drops and player-to-player trading. Place your vending stall, compare other players prices and compete with thousands of players in one shared economy.

PvP Combat: PvP battles in the Arena. Fight against players or even your friends. Participate in events, where your skill and strategy will determine victory.

PvE Combat: Many challenges await as you fight a variety of monsters. Earn experience and valuable loot as you fight through a slew of diverse enemies.

Join The Community

The community is our most important aspect. We strive to maintain a strong, engaged community, supporting our players. You're not just playing; you are helping build SpiritVale. The developer is active in our chat channels and has been constantly listening to feedback to improve SpiritVale everyday. SpiritVale is still in active development with updates being made on a weekly and even daily basis.

Fair-To-Play. Never Pay-To-Win.

We're committed to creating a fair playing field for all players. All Microtransactions in SpiritVale are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay.

3775050.name: DOGWALK
3775050.detailed_description:
Blender Studio's official game project is a short casual interactive story.
Play a big, adorable dog traversing through winter woods and help out a little kid decorate a snowman with colorful items hidden in the environment.

Explore

You are let loose to roam camping grounds, forest paths, idyllic creeks and a frozen pond in this miniature open world.

Bound together

Guide or drag around your little kid owner that you have in tow. Help each other out, be a menace or be a good boy.

Play your way

Dive straight in and have the game react to your play-style and choices.

A paper craft world

Traverse an environment made of real-life paper crafted models, scanned and recreated to be played with.

Free for everyone

Brought to you by the Blender Studio as the new free and creative commons "Open Project".
Made with, and available as free and open-source software.

The project was used to test and improve both Blender and the Godot Game Engine.

3784030.name: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
3784030.detailed_description:
RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride.

Discover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a MultiCoin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Blast a TNT Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once!

Uncover 150 unique items that can dramatically shift the course of your run. Stack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry.

Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos. 

Play as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play.

  • 6 playable characters, each with their own unique coins

  • 150 distinct coins with special effects

  • 150 power-up items with unique abilities

  • Endless run mode for infinite replayability

  • 8 difficulty levels to master

3812600.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
3812600.detailed_description:
ReStory is a chill, narrative-driven shop management simulator from the creators of I Am Future, set on the bustling streets of mid-2000s Tokyo and featuring an in-depth device repair system. 

In this game, you run an electronics repair shop, meticulously restore nostalgic Y2K-era devices, including officially licensed Atari consoles, and interact with customers to experience a branching storyline with multiple endings that depend on your choices.

Greet customers, take their devices in for repairs, manage your finances, and surf the web for spare parts. Relax and enjoy running your own small shop in a game created with love and respect for the one-of-a-kind vibe of the Japanese urban life in the mid-2000s.

Fix a variety of nostalgic devices inspired by iconic game consoles, handhelds, phones, cameras, music players, and home appliances. Carefully take each gadget apart, clean it, replace faulty parts, and assemble it back together using your trusty toolset.

The way you interact with each customer can change their lives forever. Will you report on a disturbing find inside the former gangster’s phone, or help a lovestruck student confess to his crush? Make your own choices and see how they impact the branching storyline.

Key Features

  • Relaxing electronics repair shop management

  • A wide range of nostalgic 2000s devices to repair

  • In-depth device cleaning and restoration system

  • Y2K-era web browser to hunt for spare parts

  • A variety of in-person and online orders to fulfill

  • Multiple tools for device repairs

  • Iconic Atari consoles, officially licensed for the game

  • Customers with unique stories and dialogues

  • Replayable branching storyline with choices impacting the ending

  • A distinct, chill vibe of urban life in Japan

3846120.name: MineMogul
3846120.detailed_description:
Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

Build A Sprawling Factory

Enjoy the casual construction of massive, interconnected factories deep underground. Wind conveyors through twisting mineshafts, connect machines, and harness physics to automate your every need.

Explore The Unknown

Venture into the mysterious, hollowed shell of a forgotten cave system. Discover secrets, unearth hidden resources, and rebuild among the ruins of abandoned mining operations. Every cavern holds new opportunities for the ambitious mogul.

Manage The Chaos

As your factory grows, so does the madness! Conveyors overflow, parts scatter, and unexpected physics mishaps keep you on your toes. Tweak your designs, optimize machine placement, and find creative solutions to keep the gears turning and the chaos under control.

3862670.name: Shelldiver
3862670.detailed_description:
All aboard the submarine! Shelldiver is an incremental game about a turtle fishing jellyfish and selling them at their little shop. Help our senior protagonist upgrade their equipment, explore various biomes and oceanic depths, and help out their local turtle population – maybe right after a well-deserved nap!

Your primary resource is jellyfish – the favorite meal of these turtles! With your handy bubble gun, you can chase and capture various unique types of jellyfish, each with their own unique spin – and taste, probably – then sell them at your little shop. Electric jellyfishes, mutant amalgamations, hellish jellies who explode when nearby – the more you collect, and the faster you do, the more money you get to invest back into your business!

On top of the gelatinous creatures, you will also have other types of resources floating about near the ocean floor to scrap for parts! Use your powerful laser blaster to take apart human trash, crystal rocks, mushrooms, and other distinct components, then use them to upgrade your submarine, tools and more.

The more you collect, progress and explore, the more opportunities you'll get to improve your skills. With a large branching skill tree, you can pick and choose your favorite perks and customize your future expeditions to maximize the things you want most – from your oxygen tank to the size of your shop!

The ocean is vast, and your clientele is demanding! Unlock and explore various unique biomes – from volcanic waters to crystalline caverns – as well as their varying depths and unique resources. Just don't forget to check your oxygen supply!

3868320.name: Forage Wizard
3868320.detailed_description:
Progress through a magic skill tree to unlock the secrets of the glade. Collect items and refine them into powerful magical resources. Use these items to build your own productive base. You can farm crops, slay monsters and automate your alchemical production on your journey to uncover an all-powerful artifact.

COLLECT AND MANAGE RESOURCES

Forage items from the woods with the power of your mighty cursor. Craft these into ingredients for buildings and incremental upgrades.

UNLOCK AN INCREMENTAL SKILL TREE

Explore and progress through an incremental skill tree which changes how you play. Pick the best options and become an all-powerful wizard.

BUILD A PRODUCTIVE BASE

Build machines, self-chopping trees and elemental distilleries. Organize your base to maximize your comfort or to maximize your productive output.

Feature List

  • Build structures to refine, store and generate items.

  • Do alchemy. Refine ores into ingots. Craft chaos from the elements. Concoct and harness the world's primordial matter.

  • Collect in Clicker game style. Chop wood, mine rocks, harvest wheat! You can even prong primordial cubes!

  • Access the blueprints shop to unlock new buildings.

  • Farm monsters and grow crops.

  • Trade resources for gold.

  • Uncover hidden locations deep within the woods.

  • Complete a bespoke incremental experience with constant, clear progression.

3892270.name: Gamble With Your Friends
3892270.detailed_description:
Gamble With Your Friends

An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.

FEATURES:

  • 🥳 1–6 player online co-op

  • ⏰ Around 2-3 hours of playtime with 3 endings

  • 🃏 17 different games of chance

  • 🧐 15+ sketchy items to fight the odds

  • 🏗️ 4 distinctly themed casino floors

  • 🥸 Many emotes + customization options

  • 🎙️ Proximity voice chat

  • 🎶 Original soundtrack from artists behind tracks featured in HASTE, ROUNDS, Stick Fight, POST VOID, TABS, and more

SHARING IS CARING

It’s not my money, it’s our money. Coordinate with your friends to manage a shared bank account while you gamble your way out of debt… because one bad all-in can ruin the run for everyone.

WELCOME TO JEFF BOOTH’S PARADISE

Each “day,” you get 5 minutes inside the casino to earn as much cash as possible. The tower has 4 distinctly themed floors, each with its own games of chance, randomized every time you enter. Unlock higher floors as you get richer (and bolder).

TICKETS, TRADES, AND TERRIBLE IDEAS

Hit your quota, complete unique challenges, or even sell a body part or two to earn Tickets. Spend Tickets on sketchy items to bend the odds in your team's favor. But even if you do everything “right"... Lady Luck still has the final say.

LOOK COOL WHILE YOU LOSE

Spend Tickets on cosmetics back in the neighborhood. Is it optimal? No. Is it stylish? Absolutely. (Your friends may scream at you.)

GAMBLING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Multiplayer is friends-only. Invite up to 5 friends through Steam. Solo play is possible… but not advised unless you’re feeling really lucky.

A QUICK NOTE

We don’t condone gambling! This is a co-op chaos game about teamwork, greed, and bad decisions. If gambling is a problem for you, please seek help.

⚠️ Attention: This game is digestible 😋🍴

We’re TENSTACK -a small collective making creative, digestible games. A digestible game respects your money and time, is built around one strong idea, and doesn’t overstay its welcome. Our goal: games you can finish in a couple of sessions -without feeling stuffed.

3894850.name: Nothing To Declare
3894850.detailed_description:
Out Now, Check out the Bundle! 🛃


About the Game

Ever wondered what it’s like to work airport security... without the stress? In Nothing To Declare, you step into a cozy, hand-drawn world where your job is to keep things safe, with just a sprinkle of suspicion.

From weighing luggage to scanning x-rays and questioning quirky travelers, every shift brings surprises (and the occasional questionable electronic device). Use your judgment and intuition to decide: do you let it through… or unzip and investigate?

🧳 Your Daily Routine:


  • Start Your Shift: Begin your day at the cozy airport checkpoint or behind-the-scenes baggage station.
  • Serve Passengers: Greet travelers, check passports, weigh bags, and scan them for suspicious items.
  • Investigate Further: If your gut says something’s off, dig in, literally. Unzip luggage and search with care in mini-game form.
  • Grade Your Performance: Make smart calls, earn money, and avoid penalties for mistakes. Or don't, chaos is also an option.

🔍 Mini-Games You’ll Master:


  • Bag Weighing: Check if a suitcase is pushing the limits… and guess what might be inside.
  • X-Ray Scanning: Layered, noisy bag visuals hide secrets, can you spot the danger?
  • Passenger Interviews: Choose from dialogue options to assess each traveler’s intent and honesty.
  • Luggage Searching: Unzip, poke around, and carefully examine every odd-looking item.
  • ...and more as the airport grows!

🎨 Features & Feel:


  • Hand-drawn 2D visuals full of charm and character.
  • Mini-games inspired by real security tasks, but make it cozy.
  • Light narrative elements with funny or suspicious passengers.
  • Endless replayability as each shift brings new challenges.
  • Packed (literally) with items from the Lost But Found universe, and more!

✈️ Ready to start your shift?


There’s nothing to declare… except a good time. (sorry for the bad joke)

🛫 Don't forget to wishlist now!

3934270.name: How Many Dudes?
3934270.detailed_description:
How Many Dudes? is a roguelike dudebuilder that's all about game-breaking synergies and simulated chaos.

Welcome to the Dude Ranch, where you recruit and manage your ever-expanding army of Dudes

  • Choose from a wild cast of 42 Unique Dudes across 6 Dude Families: Undead Dudes, Employed Dudes, Warrior Dudes, Fantasy Dudes, Sci-Fi Dudes, and Action Dudes.

  • Setup your Team to mix and match Dude Types and form ridiculous synergies - like Zombie Dudes who explode when struck by enemies, Ninja Dudes who throw a barrage of Shurikens, or Cowboy dudes who lasso other Dudes out of danger.

  • More than 850,000 Team compositions means there's tons of strategies and overpowered combos to discover.

Create game-breaking synergies with your choice of Dudes, Trinkets, and Relics

  • Collect hundreds of Dude Relics that warp the rules of battle. Make your Wizard Dudes fling a volley of fireballs when they move, your Ninja Dudes enter stealth when in danger, or your Finance Dudes generate cash with a life insurance policy on your other Dudes.

  • Defeat Act Bosses to earn Trinkets - powerful items assigned to a Dude Type that enable game breaking strategies. Should you give your Wizard Dudes ADHD, or give your Samurai Dudes a Taser? It's up to you!

  • Choose your Dudes wisely. Each Dude has their place in battle, from dishing out damage to tanking it to commanding other Dudes. Find the right balance between offense and defense, and see if your team can make it all the way to the final act.

Face escalating enemy waves—from toddlers to wolves to gorillas to gods

  • Conquer boss fights that test your team’s synergy (and your sanity).

  • Defeat bosses to earn Silver and Gold stars for each Dude, and see if you can master them all!

  • Strategic roguelike autobattler full of game-breaking synergies

  • 42 Unique Dude Types to recruit and build out your team

  • Hundreds of Relics, Trinkets, and Wandering Dude events that completely reshape each run

  • Three Tiers of Challenge, each with additional unique enemies and epic boss battles

  • Game modes like The Daily Dude and Ensemble Mode, which allows for pre-selecting your dream team

  • Infinite replayability and absurdity

3938640.name: Ugoku Sushi Bar
3938640.detailed_description:
Menu Reveal ✨ Wishlist Now!


About the Game

🍣 Welcome to Ugoku Sushi Bar, where conveyor belts, cozy vibes, and culinary creativity collide! 🍵

You’ve just taken over a small sushi bar tucked away in a charming Japanese town. With a humble kitchen and a head full of dreams, it’s up to you to turn your little eatery into the talk of the town.



As the conveyor belt keeps moving, so does your journey. Slice, roll, and plate an ever-growing variety of delicious Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, discover over 100 sushi recipes, and experiment with a Minecraft-style crafting system to create new sushi combinations.



  • 🎏 Prepare and Plate: Craft everything from classic sushi to creative Japanese side dishes. Timing, accuracy, and presentation matter!
  • 🍥 Conveyor Belt Chaos: Fulfill orders by placing them on the belt at the right time and in the right order, or face some seriously confused customers.
  • 😺 Quirky Regulars: Meet an eclectic cast of recurring customers, each with unique tastes, stories, and personalities. Some just want sushi, others want a chat.
  • 📚 Learn & Master Recipes: Unlock new recipes as you progress, from simple nigiri to specialty rolls and surprise seasonal dishes.
  • 🛠️ Upgrade Your Kitchen: Invest in new tools, appliances, and ingredients to boost your efficiency and expand your menu.


  • 🌸 Cozy Atmosphere: A warm, relaxing art style paired with ambient sounds and music makes every shift feel satisfying and peaceful.
  • 📈 Story & Progression: As your sushi bar grows, you’ll uncover the backgrounds of your customers, unlock new décor, and even participate in local events and food festivals.
  • 🐟 Fresh Ingredients, Fresh Challenges: Seasonal fish, special requests, and daily challenges keep you on your toes while keeping things fun.


Ugoku Sushi Bar is a cozy job simulator full of flavor, charm, and heart. Whether you're a sushi enthusiast, a fan of relaxing sim games, or just love a well-told story in a small package, this game invites you to slow down, serve up joy, and savor the little victories.

Slice. Serve. Smile. Your sushi journey starts here.

3947040.name: Pegfinity
3947040.detailed_description:
What if one ball could break the entire board?

Pegfinity is a short colorful, pachinko-inspired physics-based incremental where a single shot can spiral into massive chain reactions, exploding scores, and absurd combos.

Launch balls, hit pegs, unlock chaotic upgrades, and turn a simple board into a ridiculous score-chasing machine.

You are always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet.

Between runs, unlock upgrades that push every shot further and make the board more chaotic.

  • Stack multipliers with the Hypemeter

  • Fill the board with explosive, electric, and gold pegs

  • Unlock gadgets that cheat physics: lasers, portals, a gumball machine, even a pinball bumper

  • Launch special balls that shatter, zap, spray watermelon juice, or disco the whole screen

  • Discover pegs that steal the run: chickens, UFOs, mirrors, clowns, and an atomic bomb that hits everything

  • Chase bigger combos, bigger payouts, and bigger score spikes

With over 150 upgrades to discover, every run gives you new ways to bend the board in your favor.
Every board is randomly generated. Every upgrade sticks. The game keeps handing you new ways to break it.

From simple bounces to ridiculous chaos

End with a board filled with effects, combos, and massive score spikes. Each run escalates:

  • More hits

  • Bigger numbers

  • More unpredictable outcomes

You’re always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet.

A Satisfying Progression Loop

Every hit is a small dopamine boost. Every run builds toward something bigger. Short sessions turn into long ones.

You launch one ball…

Then another…

Then one more to try something new…

And suddenly, everything clicks.

Permanent Power-Ups

Grow stronger over time with upgrades that carry across runs:

  • Multipliers

  • Stronger pegs

  • Bigger payouts

  • Game-changing boosts

Each run feeds into the next.

Inspired by a 150-year-old game

Pegfinity is inspired by a handcrafted pachinko-style board passed down through generations.

A simple idea, rebuilt into something faster, bigger, and far more chaotic.

  • Over 150 upgrades

  • Unlock unique pegs, balls, slots and cool gadgets

  • Random generated board - Each run is something new!

  • Permanent unlockable Power Ups!

  • And of course some biiiiiiiiiiig numbers!

See you in Pegfinity!

3948120.name: Scritchy Scratchy
3948120.detailed_description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:

• Boosted odds and payouts

• Faster and easier scratching 

• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!

3949040.name: RV There Yet?
3949040.detailed_description:
DRIVE HOME

You and your buddies are on your way home from a relaxing vacation but are forced to take an alternate route. Get your RV through the back country and find the exit to Route 65.

SURVIVE MABUTTS VALLEY

Not everyone who enters Mabutts Valley makes it out alive. So be sure to keep a steady flow of burgers, antidotes, and the classic: EpiPens.

WINCH IT GOOD

Master the physics based winch and earn the right to be the main remote commander. With a winch front and rear, your RV is especially equipped to get over, under or through most road bumps.

HELP YOURSELF, AND EACH OTHER

Help yourself to cold brewskis and filtered low tar cigarettes, but don’t forget that the driver will have a hard time completing this journey alone.

A SCRAPPY BUNCH

Use everything you find to maintain the integrity of your RV and friendships.

Features:

  • Drive one RV together with up to 4 players

3966510.name: Feed the Scorchpot
3966510.detailed_description:
You struck a deal with a dragon: twenty years of protection for twenty years of dinner service. The island thrives under the beast's watchful eye, as long as the meals keep coming.

Every year, the dragon wakes up hungrier. You roll dice to work your island, harvest ingredients, fuse them into recipes, and cook them down in the Scorchpot — the pot you keep full or end up in. Get the meal right and you prosper. Get it wrong and you're smoke.

Build farmsteads, shrines, and harbors across your hex-grid island, each one changing how the board pays out. The best runs start with a handful of tiles and end with a machine that buries the dragon in food. Then the odds tighten, the dragon turns picky, and you tear the whole thing down and rebuild while it's on fire.

Feed the Scorchpot, keep the dragon happy, and outlast the contract.

  • Build a scoring engine — Place farms, shrines, and harbors so they feed each other. 50+ buildings and 80+ recipes to mix and upgrade, until a handful of tiles becomes board-breaking numbers.

  • Every meal is a math puzzle — Combine ingredients into recipes that boost Flavor and Essence, multiplying your Fodder score into absurd, screen-shaking numbers.

  • Press your luck — Win in fewer seasons for a bigger payoff, but each year you stay raises the stakes: harsher odds, hungrier dragons, the odd tantrum that torches your board.

  • Build your dice — 20+ types: odd, even, colored, even dice carved into six sixes. Tune your tray and pray the dragon's merciful.

  • Broken combos, on purpose — Bend the rules, break the math, and rebuild when everything catches fire.

  • Hand-drawn, every inch — Every dragon, building, and meal drawn by Daniela, the artist half of the married duo who made the game.

  • For combo addicts — If you've broken Balatro or Slay the Spire wide open with one overpowered synergy, you'll feel at home.

  • Quick to pick up — Roll, cook, feed: you've got the loop by your first year. Staying ahead of the dragon for twenty is the hard part.

  • Cozy on top, ruthless underneath — Hand-drawn and warm, right up until the fire catches.

    Cook cleverly, plan badly, or just roll with it — the dragon doesn't care how you win, only that you feed the beast on time. And yes, you can pet the dragon.

3968160.name: Island Beekeeper
3968160.detailed_description:
Earth is dying from disease, famine and ruin. One of the few resources still helping people survive is honey from the floating islands.

You travel to the sky world to build a beekeeping farm, raise bees and establish honey shipments back down to Earth. Other beekeepers were sent there before you, but none of them ever returned. The more islands you discover, the closer you get to the answer to the main question: what happened to those who came before you?

🐝 Bees and Hybrids

Raise bees, care for hives and collect honey. Each type of bee has its own unique traits. Crossbreed different species to create hybrids with new properties. Over time, bees will become an important part of your farm and help automate part of the work at the apiary.

🍯🏠 Building

Create your own island: expand the territory, place hives, set up crop fields and build your apiary the way you want. Build a farm, a small house with hives or a large apiary that gradually grows together with your settlement.

🌼 Gardening

Grow flowers for the bees, as well as vegetables, fruits and other plants for yourself. Some crops will help attract the right types of bees and affect the quality of the honey, while others will be useful for cooking, crafting and everyday life on the island. Choose plants that suit your apiary and gradually expand your farm with new crops.

🐝🏍️ Medocycle

The Medocycle is a unique vehicle for traveling between islands. With it you can explore new islands, find rare locations and quickly return to your apiary. Upgrade the Medocycle to reach places that were previously inaccessible.

🌤️ World Exploration

Travel between islands with different biomes, plants, resources and bee species. Each new island may offer something useful for your apiary: a rare bee, a needed material or a new crop to grow. As you explore the islands, you will uncover traces of the beekeepers who came before you and gradually learn what happened to them.

👥 Multiplayer

Play solo or with friends: develop the apiary, grow plants, build and explore islands in a shared world. Divide up tasks or do everything together - one person cares for the bees, another shapes the island, and a third heads out to find new islands and bee species.

4009450.name: Petunia's Purgatory
4009450.detailed_description:
Petunia's Purgatory is an idle farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Unlike other Idler games, your desktop becomes part of the experience as the farm keeps growing, waiting, and quietly getting worse.

Grow unusual crops, care for your farm, and make offerings to something lurking in the barn.

Keep Petunia sane as her reality begins to slip... before her hallucinations spill onto your screen.

Tend the Farm. Feed the Elder God.

Your landlord is ancient, voracious, and lives twenty feet from your front door. Keep it fed or find out what happens when you don't.

  •     Plant dozens of twisted, unsettling crops, each stranger than the last, each craved by something older than memory. Deliver them to the Eldritch beast that calls your barn home.

  •     Summon cute but creepy helpers to till, harvest, and haul. Unlock and upgrade unique helpers with special abilities to improve speed, efficiency, and the way your cursed farm operates.

  •     Attract mutated animals to your farm. Slaughter them for blood, a vital resource that keeps the harvest cycle turning.

  •     Cook and craft raw produce into prepared offerings. A feast worthy of an Elder God takes time, care, and a strong stomach.

Hold It Together, Handling cursed crops is rough on a person's mind. Petunia is tougher than she looks, but she has limits.

  •    Plant flowers and decorate your farm to maintain Petunia's sanity. Beauty is the only thing standing between her and a full breakdown.

  •    The Elder God plays games. Let your sanity slip too far, and the hallucinations will begin... and they will not be friendly.

  •    When sanity falls too low, the farm becomes harder to ignore as hallucinations interrupt your screen and disrupt the quiet routine. Restore calm with flowers and decorations before Petunia fully loses control.

  •    Balance is survival. Push the harvest too hard and Petunia breaks. Neglect it and something far worse

    happens.

It Lives on Your Desktop

Petunia's Purgatory doesn't demand your full attention. It quietly waits at the bottom of your screen while you get on with your day. Check in when you want. The farm keeps going when you don't.

  •   Desktop overlay idle gameplay: the game runs beneath your other windows, always there, never demanding.

  •   Fully customizable display scale: scale it down when you need to focus, and expand it when you're ready to tend the harvest.

Idle-friendly design: progress happens in the background. The god is patient. It has been waiting a very long time.

4015530.name: MyVoiceZoo
4015530.detailed_description:
🦄 My Voice Zoo is a unique idle zoo game brought to life with your very own voice.

Create animal cries using your microphone,

and build a one-of-a-kind zoo found nowhere else.

Whenever the animals cry, your voice echoes and income builds up.

That income can be used to adopt new animals, helping your zoo grow bigger and livelier over time.

You can enjoy it naturally without complicated controls, simply by leaving it idle,

free from competition or the pressure to optimize, and experience cozy and gentle healing.

Build and enjoy a truly special zoo, completed only with your voice!

🎙️ Key Features

  • Create Animal Voices: Roar like a lion, quack like a duck, baa like a sheep, or squawk like a penguin — every animal’s voice can be made with your own.

  • Idle Income Loop: Each time your animals cry out, income is generated and can be used to adopt even more animals.

  • Build Your Own Zoo: Your recorded voices become the animals’ cries, creating a zoo that exists nowhere else.

  • Collect & Grow: Adopt adorable animals, give them names, and expand your collection into a larger and livelier zoo.

  • Cozy & Relaxing: From moments of laughter to small surprises, enjoy stress-free fun with no competition or pressure.

🌟 Only your voice can complete this extraordinary zoo.

4018550.name: Cat Isle
4018550.detailed_description:
Cat Isle is a cozy pixel art management game inspired by Japan’s famous Cat Islands. You’ll build and expand a tiny train platform island in the middle of the sea, turning it into lively town for cats.

Manage shops

Running a town full of curious cats takes careful observation. While some cats seek out fresh sashimi, others are happiest with tea and a nap in the sun. As the island's caretaker, it’s your job to figure out who wants what and create the perfect mix and balance of shop supplies.

Unlock decorations with the Gashapon

Spin the decoration Gashapon machine to unlock cute new decorations for your island. Each capsule gives you a little surprise from cozy plants to charming shop ornaments. Collect your favorites and slowly fill your town with personality and warmth.

Decorate your town

Each building is a chance to get creative. Add plants, lights and decorations to suit both your vision and your cats personalities. Every small detail matters, adding warmth to the town and helping your shops thrive.

Vibe and chill

Also, remember to slow down and enjoy the world you’ve built. Watch the cats explore, play, and relax. Sometimes, just observing is the sweetest reward.

Key features

  • 4 levels with unique goals and themes

  • 100+ Decorations(hand drawn pixel art)

  • Sandbox mode

  • Custom Decorations

  • 17 unique buildings

  • 2-4 hours of gameplay

4026250.name: Project P.I.T.T.
4026250.detailed_description:
You are a new intern at a company with a very simple task. Craft rubber ducks and feed them to the pit.

At the center of the facility waits the Maw – a vast corporate hole with an appetite that only grows larger the more you feed it. Make ducks, throw them in, earn your place.

The company is watching. The pit is growing. Ducks will not be enough.

Unlock new tools, produce stranger objects, improve your workflow, and build increasingly chaotic physics-based systems to keep up with demand. With each phase, the Maw expands, the facility shifts, and your responsibilities become harder to explain.

Eventually, simple production turns into assembly. Objects begin to connect in unexpected ways. Your work stops feeling like a job. Where are you? Who’s your employer? Why are you doing all this?

FEATURES

  • Build absurd physics-based production lines and feed products to the Maw

  • Start with rubber ducks, then unlock stranger products, tools, and automation systems

  • Use magnets, fans, panels, pistons, launchers, and more to optimize production

  • Chain combos and improve throughput for higher payouts

  • Watch the Maw grow larger as production escalates

  • Explore a brutalist PSX-style corporate facility

4030830.name: Focus Grove
4030830.detailed_description:
Focus Grove isn’t just a game — it’s your companion for staying mindful, balanced, and productive throughout the day.

Stay on top of things with focus and planning tools that help you organize your work, studies, chores, and all the small things in between.

Complete your real-life tasks to unlock a whole world of rewards for you and your Woodlings. Discover new animals, countless hats and dresses, skins for your Tree House and much more.

Set up your tools to match the way you work. Adjust your layout freely for focus sessions, study time, planning, YouTube, or whatever your day needs.

Every completed task helps your cozy forest farm grow. Build up your farm and a lively village for your Woodlings, expand your space, and watch your progress turn into a place full of life.

KEY FEATURES

🍅  Pomodoro Timer

✅  Task tracker

🎵  Ambient nature sounds for better focus

📊  Habits tracker

📝  Notepad with tabs

👨‍🌾  Relaxing no-stress farming

🐰  Cute Woodling companions

🧘‍♀️  Tips from personal growth trainer

📊  Work statistics

🐠  Fishing album

🖥️  Adjustable tools layout

⌚  Gentle growth reminders

A word for you from Little Lantern

"We made Focus Grove because we know how hard it can be to stay motivated, make daily work feel fun, and keep a healthy balance between work and life. We struggled with this ourselves, too. That’s why we wanted to create something gentle, cozy, and helpful — something that makes it easier to move forward step by step, one carrot at a time.

Stay focused, stay cozy, stay happy.

Your Little Lanterns"

4075620.detailed_description:

Unlock new guilds as you play, each with unique identities, strengths and drawbacks. Every run will see you picking 2 different guilds to play with. You'll start with a brand-new, procedural map, and grow a tiny hamlet into a thriving city.

Break the game, refine your strategy, and build a city for the ages!

  • A pantheon of 7 guilds with unique buildings and playstyles - pick 2 every run

  • Upgrades to manipulate your buildings' behaviour, and potions to manipulate the map

4078200.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
4078200.detailed_description:
Dwarf Eats Mountain is a strategic incremental game about devouring mountains for gold. Hire dwarves, deploy war machines, and collect powerful artifacts to build absurd synergies and grow faster each run.

Hurting the mountain physically (and emotionally) is only half the battle—you still have to safely haul the gold home. That perilous job falls to the Runners, who weave through falling rocks, risking their beards to feed the Great Maw!

But beware—the Great Mother won’t give up her treasure easily. The more damage your greedy dwarves deal to the mountain, the more calamities it unleashes upon the wobbling beards below!

Balance mining with hauling your gold home—before the sky falls on your head.

Master the dwarven ways of treasure extraction!
This game is about making numbers go up, but the way you do that is open to your interpretation and ingenuity. At your fingertips:

  • Many buildings and dwarves, each with various strengths and weaknesses, such as dynamite throwers, ballistas, flamers, laser cannons, spelunkers, runesmiths, brewmasters, bulldozers, gyrocopters and more!

  • Acquire countless upgrades and cast active rituals to buff your dwarves and their machines

  • Collect 120+ ancient artifacts and display them in your gallery, each with build-shaping effects

  • Unlock 96+ prestige upgrades to replay, accelerate progress, and discover new synergies

  • Spend rare resources like mithril and mountain souls on tough choices

  • Uncover what the gods have hidden beneath the world spire—and what happened to those who dug too deep

4098230.name: Flats Full of Cats
4098230.detailed_description:
Flats Full of Cats is a cozy hidden object game where you explore adorable apartments packed with feline friends!

Discover three themed apartments inspired by science, mystery, and adventure! Join a policeman, a paleontologist, and a scientist in their cat-filled homes — each packed with unique details, hidden clues, and plenty of furry friends waiting to be found.

Search every corner, find all the hidden cats, and enjoy charming hand-drawn visuals and relaxing music. It’s the purrfect game for cat lovers and anyone looking for a wholesome, stress-free experience.


What is Flats Full of Cats?

Flats Full of Cats is a building not bound by time or space (or even logic!); it lets us explore fun and creative ideas that wouldn’t have enough content to become full standalone games.

Each floor is a self-contained episode with its own story and a quest that connects the three apartments it holds.


Flats Full of Cats includes three play modes:

  • Normal Mode features 300 cats with detailed designs that match the theme of each floor.

  • Expert Mode features 300 minimalist cats designed for players with sharp eyes and plenty of experience.

  • Time Attack Mode is a replay-oriented mode that generates a mix of 100 cats and records how long you take in each apartment – and if you’re not in the mood for this mode, that’s perfectly fine; you don’t need to play it to complete the story.


As cats, we always appreciate free treats, so the first floor is free to play!

And since every cat deserves to explore at their own pace, you can simply purchase the themes you find most interesting and embark on a feline adventure filled with magic, laughter, and inspiration!

  • Time Attack Mode is a replay-oriented mode that generates a mix of 100 cats and records how long you take in each apartment – and if you’re not in the mood for this mode, that’s perfectly fine; you don’t need to play it to complete the story.


As cats, we always appreciate free treats, so the first floor is free to play!

And since every cat deserves to explore at their own pace, you can simply purchase the themes you find most interesting and embark on a feline adventure filled with magic, laughter, and inspiration!

4111370.name: Birdwatching Notebook
4111370.detailed_description:
Birders, assemble!

We've developed a cozy idle game just for you. Now, you can enjoy birdwatching from the comfort of your desktop, too!

Place your postcard — a window to another world — right at the corner of your screen.

Decorate your favourite birding spot to your heart's content. If a bird happens to fancy your humble abode, it just might stop by for a visit!

Join us on Discord!

Unlock a variety of birding spots! The docks, beaches, deserts, even rainforests…

Each place has its own unique scenery, and new bird species to discover!

Your Birding Area can be freely manipulated!

Zoom, move, and arrange your favourite birding spot however you like

— the birds will keep you company while you work.

The Blueprint System is now live!

You can save your builds, share them, and quickly switch between different designs!

Sparrows aren't the only birds that want to hang out.

There are dozens of other bird species, too!

They have their own preferred times to visit — maybe you can capture something wonderful!

The more a bird visits, the more comfortable they'll feel!

You might be able to discover new behaviors over time…

Snap! Immortalize your favourite moments with your camera.

Once you've documented every unique behavior from a bird, you'll earn a statue of them!

Any new lifers today?

Your handbook also keeps a record of Birding Areas, decoration, photographs, achievements, and more!

If you enlarge the main illustration, you'll be able to discover just what traits make that bird special!

You can change the time of day and weather of your Birding Area as you desire.

Regardless of time, or weather, you'll meet a new friend who enjoys it, that's for sure!In the night, nocturnal birds await…

Join your friends for a birdwatching session!

Transform into a little bird and land in your friends’ birdwatching spots, leaving behind emotes, photos, and little gifts as keepsakes.

You can also request and collect blueprints of other players’ birdwatching spots, bringing your favorite layout inspirations back to your own Birdland.

Your bird friends will bring all sorts of trinkets for you to collect!

They'll drop all sorts of colorful feathers, and maybe more…

Boss Crow loves anything that sparkles — whether it be shimmering feathers, or the bright glint of bottle caps!

He'll return the favor in Crow Coins!

More features are under development:

you'll be able to share gorgeous birding spots with your friends, and more…

4113940.name: Sovereign Tower
4113940.detailed_description:
- Your Reign, Your Rules - Every choice you make defines your legacy and the fate of your Kingdom... 

- Recruit eccentric Knights - Manage a court of unpredictable heroes with big egos and even bigger problems. 

- Manage Your Round Table - Send Knights on quests where success or disaster hinges on your judgment. 

- Bend Time and Tempt Fate - Rewind decisions, uncover secrets, and pursue forbidden romances. 

- Expand Your Tower - Build new annexes, acquire upgrades, and outwit rival rulers. 

Ah, finally - a suitable Sovereign for the job. Yes, you, right there, come sit on this comfy throne. Ah you like the feel of that, don’t you? Congratulations, you’re hired! My name is Arlin and I’m your advisor. Welcome to your first day, and please, allow me to provide thee with a day in the life of a Sovereign and you can then decide how will you rule, my liege...

- In the morning you must tend to your subjects and listen to the problems that plague the Kingdom. From gardening to exorcisms - there’s never a boring day on the throne. 

- Each decision you make will shape your kingdom and relationships with individuals, collectives and other rulers. Every interaction will play a part in defining your legacy. 

- Balance your affinity with the Merchants, Mystics, Scholars, Nobles and People, as well as the Treasury, or spend it all and backstab everyone. Either way works, my grace. 

- Recruit eccentric Knights with strong personalities and questionable morals to serve at your Round Table. Unfortunately for you, these are the jesters you’re relying on to keep your Kingdom running smoothly. 

- With great egos, comes great drama! These Knights aren’t going to be a walk in the Tower’s Garden, sire. There’s always advice to be taken, grievances to be shared and romance to be explored. 

- You must keep your Knights satisfied otherwise they may just leave your court for good. Maybe that’s sometimes for the best though... 

- Manage your Knights from the Round Table. Here you can view all the requests from your subjects that you obliged to earlier in the day. Assign the most equipped Knight for the job to reduce chances of failure. 

- Your Knights possess stats: Strength, Agility, Charisma, Magic and Wit. Each Quest requires a different skill set. Need a Charismatic approach? Maybe we shouldn’t send Ursula, your grace. 

- After they return from their Quests, you’ll be debriefed with the results of their venture. Did their efforts result in Critical Failure or Critical Success? Or did they experience a completely Unexpected Outcome? 

- In the Crypts of the Tower dwells a Demon who can turn back time. So, if it all goes wrong, you can go back with all the knowledge you’ve learned, make alternate decisions and change fate. 

- Of course, you have me, your main advisor at your service, but there are others. For example, The Intendant has a nosy habit of collecting secrets about your Knights. She’ll provide the juicy gossip as you require it it! 

- If you like romancing stone statues, then you’ve come to the right place. No, really, go speak to the Lady of the Tower and find out. 

- Prove your worthiness against opposers by joining hands with neighbouring counties and forging great alliances. 

- Expand your Tower by adding new Annexes which in turn will allow for more positions to open amongst your court. 

- From Carina’s Forge to the Witch’s Alchemy Room, each of these new Annexes gives you the ability to craft new items to assist your Knights on their Quests.

4117730.detailed_description:
Slay the day away in a run-based battle-tops game from the creator of Nanomon Virtual Pet, Kardboard Kings, and Desert Child. 

Battle your 'blade with SUPREMELY SATISFYING controls!

THEN, Spend the Cash you won to buy NEW PARTS!

AND THEN, Find INSANE combos with all the parts you Unlock!

Features

  • Build your Slayblade

  • Battle your Slayblade

  • Bet your lunch money on your Slayblade

  • Collect over 60+ parts for your Slayblade

  • Break the law with your Slayblade

  • Visit a miniature PS1 city with your Slayblade

  • Save the city from a rich loser with your Slayblade

✅ What Slayblade IS:

  • A snappy experience: Colourful lo-fi visuals, simple/satisfying battles, and fun customization.

  • No big story mode, just a brief intro+Outro cutscene.

4120790.name: The Sorting Bureau
4120790.detailed_description:
Every Item Has Its Place

A desk covered in someone's life. Vintage buttons, foreign coins, delicate stamps, old gears, and forgotten sweets. Pick up each item and find where it belongs.

Every Material Has Its Sound

Metal clinks. Fabric rustles. Wood thuds. Each item snaps into its container with a satisfying click. The kind of sound you want to hear over and over.

Stories Told Through Objects

Every request comes from someone real. A watchmaker and his gears. A pastry chef and her molds. A manga artist buried in brushes and sketches. They bring their boxes and ask for help. Sort through their things and piece together their stories.

Your Evening Ritual

New boxes show up every morning. New clients, new items, new sorting rules. Your quiet evening never runs out.

Features

  • Sort hundreds of tactile items across dozens of themed desks
  • No timers, no penalties, no scores. Play at your own pace
  • ASMR sound design: every material sounds different
  • Charming clients, each with their own personality and story
  • Endless requests. There's always another desk waiting
  • A cozy workshop tucked away in a quiet Tokyo neighborhood

4121170.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
4121170.detailed_description:
Fears to Fathom [Together] is an episodic psychological co-op horror game where each episode unveils a short story narrated by the ones who survived.

Fears to Fathom : Scratch Creek

In this episode of Fears to Fathom, you play as Tessa Langley or Marcus Reed — a young couple from Oregon preparing to move to another state. Due to unforeseen circumstances, their journey took an unexpected turn, leading them to the town of Scratch Creek. Little did they know what was transpiring in the decrepit small town. The couple survived as they collectively made the right choices.

The Gameplay

This game is primarily a 2-player narrative co-op walking simulator with driving and exploration mechanics. Scratch Creek is an exclusively co-op experience.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric environment.

  • VHS film aesthetic.

  • Proximity Voice Chat.

  • Receive texts from NPCs.

  • Text the other survivor.

  • Player voice activity.

  • Duo Matchmaking

  • 2-Player Co-Op.

Note:

THIS PRODUCT IS ONLINE CO-OP ONLY. Experience with a friend or find a survivor in-game.

4126480.detailed_description:
Fishing Inc is an addictive incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler.

Catch Fish!

Travel to many of the locations and catch all the fish in the areas! To catch fish you will need to click till you reach the goal target before you lose the fish! 

Log Your Catches

Over time you will get better at catching certain species of fish, you will learn their tricks and it will let you catch bigger and higher quality fish! You will discover many fish species as you travel trough the fishing locations! 

Upgrades

To become the best fisherman you will need all the best gear and upgrades, once you come back from your fishing trips you can spend your hard earned money on many upgrades that will help you catch bigger and more exotic fish

4131730.name: VHOLUME
4131730.detailed_description:
In the derelict capital of Afro-Eurasia, ruled by an all-controlling Ministry, Robert embarks on a bureaucratic quest to restore his family’s revoked ration tickets.

Movement-centric gameplay where the player can jump, run, climb and slide with great freedom. Environments challenge both agility and creativity.

Mastery-driven players can exploit momentum, discover shortcuts, and break the labyrinthine design, making each run a test of skill and efficiency as they chase target times.

Play solo, or join friends in multiplayer and experience every level together.

See other players’ ghosts, share your own, and discover new ways through each level.

Steam workshop support: Play levels made by the community or create your own.

4132330.name: Pizza House Simulator🍕
4132330.detailed_description:
🍕 Welcome to Pizza House Simulator

Build and manage your own pizzeria on the beautiful streets of the Amalfi Coast.

Prepare authentic pizzas, manage your kitchen, customize your restaurant, survive chaotic rush hours, and turn a struggling family business into a thriving Italian restaurant empire.

From peaceful seaside mornings to absolute dinner-time chaos every shift tells a different story.

🔥 Master of the Kitchen

Prepare ingredients, stretch dough by hand, manage your oven, repair broken stations and keep impatient customers satisfied before the restaurant falls into chaos.

Upgrade your kitchen equipment, automate stations with major improvements, hire assistants, and build the ultimate pizza making machine.

🌦️ Experience a Living Italian Town

Enjoy dynamic day & night cycles, seasonal weather, rainy evenings, foggy mornings, snowy winters, and the warm atmosphere of a living Mediterranean town.

The world around your restaurant changes over time with random events, shifting customer behavior, economic crises, and unexpected disasters affecting your business.

📈 Build Your Restaurant Empire

Take loans from the bank, invest in the stock market, follow economic news, and react to changing ingredient prices.

Listen to radio broadcasts and read local newspapers to predict future events before the market reacts.

A tomato farmer strike today might become tomorrow’s financial opportunity.

🪑 Customize Everything

Design your restaurant exactly the way you want.

Unlock decorations, kitchen upgrades, equipment, buffs, and customization options through progression, quests, and gameplay achievements.

Create anything from a small cozy family pizzeria to a luxurious Italian restaurant.

⚡ Shape Your Own Playstyle

Choose mottos and management styles that affect gameplay.

Prioritize customer satisfaction, maximize profits, automate your workflow, or embrace total chaos.

Ignore broken equipment, push your staff too hard and deal with the consequences including fires, thieves, mafia incidents and unexpected disasters.

👨‍🍳 Play Solo, Co-op or With Your Community

Play alone with systems balanced for singleplayer or team up with friends in online co-op multiplayer for up to 6 players.

Compete against other restaurants, climb leaderboards, and prove your restaurant is the best in town.

With Twitch integration, invite viewers directly into your restaurant, interact with them in real time, and create chaotic live gameplay moments together.

4156580.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator
4156580.detailed_description:
Weed Supermarket Simulator is a chill first-person simulation game where you run your own weed store.

Open and manage your shop as you sell weed, bongs, and other smoking gear. Set up shelves, display cases, and counters to make shopping easy and fun for all kinds of customers.

Grow your own weed from seed to harvest. Build a grow room, plant seeds, and take care of your plants. Upgrade and improve your strains to create high-quality weed that sells for more.

Order weed and supplies on an in-game computer. Get deliveries, unpack boxes, store items in the back room, and place products on shelves, in fridges, or in locked display cases.

Serve customers at the counter. Scan items, take cash, and keep everyone happy - or at least nicely high.

Use your profits to expand your business. Make your shop bigger, improve the interior, unlock new strains, and sell premium products.
