4158870.name: Japanese Rural Life Adventure
4158870.detailed_description:
Japanese Rural Life Adventure is a relaxing slow-life simulation where you can experience the charm of traditional Japanese countryside living, all in a beautifully crafted pixel-art world.

◆Live in the Japanese countryside surrounded by nature.

Fix up an old house, make the yard nice, grow your own crops, and become self-sufficient.

View the cherry blossoms in the spring;

attend the festival in the summer;

eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall;

hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year.

◆Self-Sufficiency: Hard Work, Deep Flavor

Rice --- the essential source of energy for the people in Japan.

Salt, soy sauce, miso ---- seasonings no Japanese kitchen can do without.

In this countryside, many things city dwellers take for granted must be made by hand.

By standing in the kitchen or cooking around the traditional irori hearth of your heritage home,

you can simulate preparing a wide variety of dishes and seasonings.

Food made through your own effort tastes extra special.

Don't be surprised if the game makes you hungry!

◆Bring back life to the village through various events

Many events unfold depending on the season, location, and time of day.

A villager might ask you to repair an old waterwheel,

or to help reopen a shuttered candy shop.

Strengthen your relationships with the locals and restore the liveliness the village once had.

As you complete requests and interact with the villagers, you may earn useful items or unlock new areas to explore.

■Game Features

- Grow crops, gather materials, and produce goods to gradually improve your heritage home.

- Enjoy a wide variety of activities, including fishing and bug catching.

- Meet many villagers in your new hometown, help them with their troubles, and complete missions to open up new areas.

- Over 100 hours of total playtime packed with numerous in-game missions.

■Game System

Your journey begins as the protagonist, a newcomer from the city, starts a solitary life in an old countryside house.

Start by clearing the overgrown weeds, cleaning the floors, and repairing the "shoji" paper screens.

By the time you've completed the tutorial, you'll have learned the basics of village life.

Each morning, an elderly woman visits to sell daily necessities, and each afternoon, a man arrives to buy items you no longer need. Buy and sell goods as you steadily gather everything required to thrive in the village and complete your missions.

4160210.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
4160210.detailed_description:
You arrive in the lands of Glimmith, a kingdom above the clouds. Your newest benefactor has hired you, a famed stained glass artisan, to help him restore the area to its former glory. However, he has given you an unusual stipulation: use whatever colors you please, so long as you follow the rules!

A cozy hamlet, an enchanted forest, and a forlorn castle await. Keep your eyes open for hidden paths and secret puzzles nestled away for the most observant players.


  • Curated, Not Generated: Experience a journey handcrafted by human puzzle designers.

  • Variety: Discover over 20 unique rule types while you color, cut, and join beautiful stained glass artworks.

  • Mastery: Optional finale puzzles put experts to the test. These challenges require you to use every trick you’ve learned to pass.

Create your own puzzles and share them with the community using the in-game level editor.

4163030.name: Cat Chess
4163030.detailed_description:
Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess with... CATS!

Everything is more fun, cute and chaotic with cats, including the game of chess!
So sit back, and lead your furry friends to The Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers.
Classic chess reinvented with attitude, humor, and, of course, adorable cats.

We are not saying this game will change the future of gaming…

BUT… there SHOULD be a chess game with cats, right?

How come there isn’t one? How can that be?!

  • Online & Offline Mode: Challenge your friends in custom online matches or kick back with local offline play whenever you want

  • You VS Computer: Test your strategy against a versatile Bot that scales all the way up to 3000 ELO

  • Single Player Campaign: Tackle a series of challenges and unlock more goodies!

  • Classic chess mechanics with a feline twist

  • Each piece is a unique cat breed with expressive animations and personality

  • Every interaction between pieces is fun, cute and funny

  • Stray Cats - fierce, witty, rebellious

  • House Cats - elegant, calculated, smug

  • Funny emotes, quick matches, and chaotic charm

  • Play with your cats while waiting for the opponent’s turn

  • FEN Support: Play custom positions easily with FEN (Forsyth-Edwards Notation)

  • Make your own Purr-fect Cats and Match: Customize your cat colors, skins, board elements and more!

4178020.name: Lured In
4178020.detailed_description:
Lured In is a cozy idle tycoon game about running your own aquarium. With your grandpa retiring, it's up to you to take the helm. Catch fish to fill your tanks, and earn revenue from your visitors. Start from a rundown empty building, and work your way up to a thriving fishing empire!

Fishing

What good is an aquarium without fish? Travel to unique zones to catch different fish for cash profit, or passive income. Pay attention to weather patterns to try and find them all. Upgrade your equipment, master every fishing minigame, and hope for a rare catch!

Show off Your Catch

Bring your fish back home and put them up on display! Each fish generates passive income, whether that's while playing, or when the game is closed. Take care of your tanks by cleaning, feeding, decorating, and more!

Business Management

There's more to running an aquarium than just fishing! Spend your cash on upgrades for your tanks to raise your passive income. Invest back into your shop, expand the business, and open new revenue streams. Once you've upgraded all you can, start fresh in a new location for unique and powerful ascension upgrades!

Decorations and Outfits

There are plenty of places to spend that extra cash! Customize the shop of your dreams, and fill it with decor that best fits your style. Your tanks can also be decorated and designed any way you want! They say to dress for the job you want. Spice up your look with tons of unlockable cosmetics to be the aquarium manager you want to see in the world.

4195110.name: Ultrapool
4195110.detailed_description:
The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

Get comfy, choose a cocktail, and get ready for a very special game of pool. Assemble a triangle of balls with strange effects and get the sickest trickshots. The bartenders won't be easy to impress!

Ultrapool is an arcade-y colorful roguelike that plays like a pool version of Balatro and Super Auto Pets. Pocketing balls gives you score, and extra score gives you money you can spend at the bar to buy and improve your set of balls. Try to survive 10 rounds!

We got both! Easy to pick up pool mechanics: just get the balls in the holes! But as you discover the wacky abilities the balls have, you'll get new ideas of how to get your score ever higher.

A ghost ball that reappears on the table? A chicken ball that lays spherical eggs? A bomb that explodes if you bump it too much? The Earth? Anything is possible (as long as it's round and it rolls nicely, no cubes allowed!)

Once you think you know the game, the cocktail bar opens. Ask the bartender to mix any two balls and he will serve you something special! Some of these will feel like they should break the game wide open, but you'll need every edge you can get if you want to pull off an all nighter.

4195600.name: AFK Journey
4195600.detailed_description:
The Digimon Adventure crossover is now live!

Taichi and Agumon, along with Yamato and Gabumon, have arrived in Esperia!

Log in during the event to claim the crossover heroes! Don't miss the chance to earn 30 exclusive Invite Letters!

Enjoy a fun summer alongside the DigiDestined and their Partner Digimon! Set out on an adventure with courage—and with your friends by your side!

Welcome to the enchanted land of Esperia! Play as the legendary mage Merlin and explore a beautifully illustrated storybook world. Outsmart your foes in strategic card battles and uncover the secrets of this world alongside other heroes.

1,000 Recruits | Claim Launch Heroes

Log in and claim all launch heroes!

Begin your journey with your dream formation!

Play Smart | Adapt Formations for Different Strategies

Power isn't everything! It's possible to defeat stronger opponents with your wit and strategy!

Deploy heroes from six classes, position them strategically, and time their ultimates to overcome your enemies! Use faction buffs, terrain, and battle mechanics to your advantage!

Shared Levels | Deploy New Heroes Immediately

Equipment and levels are shared across heroes. No more grinding!

Feel free to try out different formations at zero cost!

100 Heroes | Original and Unique Designs

Meet 100 heroes from seven factions!

Witness the Lightbearers, who carry the pride of humanity. Watch the Wilders flourish at the heart of their forest. Observe how the Maulers survive against all odds through sheer strength. The Graveborn legions are amassing, and the eternal clash between the Celestials and the Hypogeans rages on. And then there are the Dimensional heroes, visiting from distant worlds. Discover their skills and captivating backstories.

Excellent Graphics | Immersive, Vast Magical World

Explore the storybook-style magical world, where every detail is meticulously crafted.

Roam through forests and mountains, using vines and tree stumps to bridge waterfalls and rivers as you take in the stunning scenery. Along the way, enjoy a range of interactive experiences, such as petting stray cats on the streets, going ice-skating, and having snowball fights... Every moment is full of surprises!

Epic Adventures | Uncover Secrets as Magister Merlin

A new adventure awaits with every season!

Long ago, the seed of life drifted to Esperia from the stars and took root, giving birth to a land of wonder. However, as the gods fell during a chaotic war, six great factions emerged, each vying for power and dominance. Remember, only you can guide heroes to pull "the sword from the stone" and learn the truth about the world.

Collect Resources Quickly | Level Up Fast

Say goodbye to grinding for resources. Collect rewards effortlessly with our auto-battle and AFK features. Continue gathering resources even while you're sleeping.

Enjoy hassle-free resource collection and smooth, rewarding progression!

4197610.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
4197610.detailed_description:
【Synopsis】

A mischievous fairy has left the once-majestic library in utter chaos. The principal’s word is law: "You are forbidden from leaving until all 3,072 books are returned to their rightful places!" In the silent, mystical archive, your long battle against the mountain of books begins.

【Gameplay: Library Organization Simulator】This is a first-person organization simulator set in a magical library

  • Categorization: From Destructive Magic and The Travels of Otherworld to Romance Novels—use titles and cover designs as clues to transport a massive collection to the correct sections.

  • Massive Volume: With 3,072 books to organize, the task may seem overwhelming at first. However, as you stack each book, you will unlock magical abilities that drastically boost your efficiency.

【Key Features】

  • Visual Satisfaction: There is a special joy in seeing the books that once cluttered the floor return to the shelves, slowly revealing the hidden floor beneath. As chaos transforms into perfect order, you’ll experience an unparalleled sense of satisfaction.

  • Strategic Efficiency: How will you combine your unlocked abilities? What order will you tackle the mess? The strategic fun lies in your decision-making, as your tactics can lead to a dramatic increase in workflow.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: The library’s ambient sound and BGM change dynamically; as shelves fill up, the acoustic resonance grows stronger, drawing you deeper into the world.

  • The Principal’s Strict Evaluation: Your precision is being monitored. The Principal’s evaluation shifts in real-time based on how many rows are "correctly shelved" according to the rules. Accuracy and speed are the keys to a perfect score—and your escape.

【Efficiency via Magical Abilities】 As you progress, you can unlock powerful magical abilities to aid your work

  • Assemble: A spell that summons other volumes of the same series directly to your hands.

  • Insight: Highlights other volumes of the same series, making them easy to spot even in a disorganized pile.

  • Auto-Shelving: A spell that instantly places the books in your hands onto the shelves in perfect order.

4210580.name: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️
4210580.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Start from a small warehouse, buy properties, dig deep for resources, process what you extract, and turn it into profit. Expand step by step and turn a simple setup into a fully functioning factory.

Play solo or with up to 4 players, running the entire operation yourself or working together to build it faster!

Procedural Mining at Its Core

Every property features procedurally generated underground resources with no fixed paths, allowing you to dig freely and shape your own tunnels.

Start with a shovel, move on to pickaxes for tougher layers, use jackhammers to speed things up, and clear large sections with dynamite. As you go deeper, resources become more valuable, making each decision more important.

From Warehouse to Industrial Production

Your factory starts with simple machines and basic resources, then expands as you unlock new machines and recipes through progression and licenses.

Handle logistics with pallets and forklifts, connect your machines with conveyor belts to create more efficient production flows, gradually turning your warehouse into a larger and more capable industrial system.

Buy Properties, Dig for Profit

Purchase different types of properties, each featuring randomized resource distribution and profit potential.

From small backyards to big construction sites, forest areas, and large quarries on snowy mountains, each location offers a different environment and opportunities.

Dig, extract, process, and turn every property into profit as you grow into larger and more valuable operations.

Contracts, Sales, and Growth

Take on contracts from companies requesting specific products and quantities, negotiate deals, prepare deliveries, and load trucks to fulfill orders for higher rewards.

Manage your stock, use smart warehouse robots, organize shipments, and balance your growth with fast stock sales.

Tools, Upgrades, and Equipment

Begin with simple tools and unlock and upgrade more powerful mining equipment as you progress.

Upgrade your factory to expand your operation, increase your market reach, take on more contracts, improve negotiation rates, hire and manage workers, and gain licenses that unlock new machines and production lines.

Customize your character with different outfits, faces, gloves, and helmets, and personalize your factory with walls, floors, signs, and decorations.

Build Solo or Scale Together

Run everything yourself or work together as a team. Take full control and progress at your own pace, or split the work, optimize production, and grow faster together.

Core Features:

  • Procedurally generated underground with fully diggable terrain and no fixed mining paths

  • Unlockable and upgradeable mining equipment including shovel, pickaxe, jackhammer, and explosives

  • Property system with multiple types, each featuring randomized ore distribution and profit potential

  • Multi-stage production system with machines enabling different processing outputs

  • Factory progression driven by machine unlocks, licenses, expanding production chains, upgrades

  • Conveyor-based production system with integrated factory automation, including warehouse robots

  • Logistics and transport using controllable vehicles such as forklifts and trucks

  • Contract system with production requirements, delivery preparation, loading, and negotiation mechanics

  • Character and factory customization

  • Fully playable solo or co-op with up to 4 players

4258770.name: Dread Fields
4258770.detailed_description:
THE GAME IN WHICH RURAL ROUTINE MEETS MYSTICISM AND DARKNESS.

A Quiet Place

"Life in the big city has become too tiring and stressful for me.

I have decided to sell my apartment and move to the countryside.

A strange old man sold me a house with a small farm in the middle of nowhere.

The locals call this area Dread Fields.

Great, so no one from my old life will be looking for me here.

I hope that a measured life, physical labor, and fresh air will bring happiness back to my life."

Rural Routine

Now you are the owner of a small farm, so you have to:

  • milk the cow

  • mow the grass

  • carry water from the well

  • feed the cat

  • pick mushrooms in the forest

  • chop wood

  • fish

  • grow plants

  • take care of the garden

  • feed the chickens and pick eggs

Features

  • 1.5 hours for average playthrough

  • ending depends on your choices

  • aesthetics of the Eastern European village (somewhere in Ukraine)

  • graphics stylized as mid-2000s games

  • atmosphere of loneliness and isolation

4294490.name: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
4294490.detailed_description:
A fun, laid-back game

No one will rush you, or watch your every step, or criticize your actions. You can meditatively sift through garbage looking for interesting things... or just run around with a trash bag! Your dump site, your rules!

Find 'em all!

There are dozens of unique cards with hand-drawn illustrations by the world's best artists!* Collect sets of different colors to earn rewards. If you're lucky, you'll find an unopened cereal box with a super-rare foil card inside!

------

*According to the artists themselves

Mend and swap cards!

A dump site is not a good place to store cards. Often, you'll be find cards that are crumpled, damaged... or torn into pieces even. Don't worry; you can mend them or swap them for better ones! The better the card's condition, the more expensive it is!

Hidden treasures

In addition to collectible cards, you can find lots of interesting things at the dump site that were thrown away by mistake or by accident. The site owner will pay you well for each such find!

Garbage makes you better

Upgrade yourself to become better, faster, stronger, and more efficient at clearing tons of garbage. Turn yourself into a veritable trash-mowing machine!

4304930.name: Chef Knight
4304930.detailed_description:
Chef Knight is a cozy fantasy incremental game where monsters aren’t just enemies – they’re ingredients.

Dive into dangerous dungeons, defeat monsters to collect fresh ingredients, return to your kitchen to cook delicious meals, then sell your dishes to upgrade before your next run!

Explore top-down dungeons filled with monsters both deadly & delicious. Aim your attacks, dodge dangerous traps, and unlock powerful culinary weapons to handle the darkest depths of the dungeon!

Turn your spoils into scrumptious dishes back in the kitchen. Discover new ingredients, unlock recipes, and watch your monster cuisine grow from simple meals into highly sought-after delicacies!

Sell your dishes to passing adventurers and reinvest the profits into powerful upgrades from a vast skill tree. Improve how fast you fight, how efficiently you cook, and how far you can push each run!

4315040.name: Hearth and Hamlet
4315040.detailed_description:
From Campfire to Kingdom. Citybuilder Clicker.

Hearth and Hamlet is a cozy incremental citybuilder set in a magic-filled medieval pixel art world. Gather resources, assign workers, construct buildings and slowly, steadily turn a quiet frontier camp into a magnificent, thriving kingdom.

From humble beginnings to magical new heights, you’ll grow your settlement one decision at a time and discover more of what the world has to offer along the way.

RUN YOUR KINGDOM YOUR WAY

Building is only the beginning. As your settlement grows, managing it becomes just as important as expanding it. Set laws and policies to shape how your kingdom operates, including taxation rules to boost income, rules for workers that keep morale high, city guard drafts to protect your population and civic decisions that change the character of your kingdom.

Every upgrade feeds into a research tree that permanently unlocks new technologies, from more advanced buildings and new policies, to stronger magic to experiment with. There’s always something worth working toward.

EXPLORE MAGIC AND TRADE WITH FARAWAY LANDS

Unlock magic as your city advances and discover wild new possibilities, such as alchemical labs and magical academies that add a whole new dimension to how your kingdom operates. 

Trade with strange new lands to build resources and grow your economy. Recruit soldiers as your realm expands to protect what you’ve built. There’s a world of wonder to discover as your empire grows.

FEATURES 

  • Incremental idle kingdom builder. A cozy, satisfying gameplay loop that rewards patience and planning..

  • Medieval pixel art world. Lakes and rivers, magical swamps, faraway lands, and more. All rendered in a charming pixel style.

  • Deep building system. From simple tents to taverns, castles, magical academies, defensive fortifications, and much more.

  • Manage resources, workers and policies. Assign your population to gather resources like food, wood, stone and gold. Set policies and laws that shape how your kingdom grows.

  • Research new technologies. Permanently unlock new buildings, magic and upgrades as your civilization advances. Discover magic, alchemy and more.

  • Trade with faraway lands. Grow your economy beyond what your local terrain provides by establishing trade routes with neighbouring kingdoms.

  • Relax, build and grow. Gameplay is engineered to be relaxing and satisfying. Watch your kingdom grow on your terms, at your pace.

4324480.name: Dirty Business
4324480.detailed_description:
Add To Wishlist


Join Our Community


About the Game

Build, upgrade, and expand an underground criminal operation beneath the city. Produce drugs, weapons, counterfeit money, and other illegal activities. Hire workers, grow your gang, optimize production, operate secret cartel airstrip and expand into city-wide distribution. Take control of districts and build your empire from the shadows in single-player or co-op.

Illegal Production

Produce multiple drugs, counterfeit different currencies, and manufacture various weapons. Complete customer orders or sell them directly for maximum profit.

Control Distribution

Send small and medium orders to the surface via elevator, and use front company vehicles for larger shipments.
Dispatch massive orders from your secret cartel airstrip to distant parts of the city and across the country.
Handle distribution yourself or hire street dealers to move products across the city.

Build Your Crew

Hire workers to grow plants, produce chemical drugs, and manufacture weapons, then hire street dealers to handle drug sales across the city.

Upgrade Your Underground Base

Expand and upgrade your underground base over time, unlock side production rooms, and open an underground garage to support a large-scale distribution fleet.

Play Solo or Co-op

Play solo or team up with up to 4 friends in co-op to build and grow your criminal empire together.

4358690.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
4358690.detailed_description:
You are the Grand Inquisitor now! Restore the Town and lead your undead army into battle to save the realm from a zombie apocalypse. Welcome to Graveyard Keeper 2 - the sequel to the original, unhinged classic!

  • Manage your own medieval graveyard

  • Automate your production like never before

  • Lead your zombie army into battle and fortify the Town against the undead

  • Rebuild The Town and milk its residents for maximum profits

  • A world full of unhinged humour, grotesque characters and a twisted story

Build and manage your own medieval graveyard. Harvest as much flora, fauna, and human remains as you can to build extraordinary machinery, automate production, and expand your graveyard for pure profit.

Become the Inquisitor and lead your undead army into battle to save the Kingdom from a zombie apocalypse. Build towers and fortifications, craft powerful armour and weapons, arm and train your not-so-smart troops, and slash your way to victory!

Help the townsfolk restore their homes and turn their problems into revenue. Complete quests throughout the city, as your undead workers take care of the heavy lifting behind the scenes. With zombie-based automation and structured systems, you can transform local efforts into a scalable and profitable operation.

4369130.name: Chop Chop Inc.
4369130.detailed_description:
Cut, Process, Craft, Distribute

You got fired from Furnox Corp 🖕.
Now you start over with nothing but an axe, a few trees and revenge on your mind (╯‵□′)╯︵┻━┻

Chop down trees, turn logs into planks, craft furniture and sell it for profit. Reinvest your money into better tools, new machines and faster production. What begins as manual labor grows into optimized production lines and high value furniture sets that grant bonus payouts.

Unlock new areas, discover new tree types, expand your operation step by step and improve your character with strength and stamina upgrades.

 

🌳 Cut down trees

Trees of all shapes, sizes, colors and questionable physics.

If it stands upright and looks even remotely choppable, congratulations: It’s firewood now!

🪵 Collect & process resources

Turn raw nature into refined building materials using machines that absolutely should not be left unattended.

  • Logs become planks.

  • Planks become furniture.

  • Furniture becomes profit. 💰

🔨 Craft like a maniac

Create furniture, props and tools, including deeply unnecessary but deeply impressive designs like:

  • A wooden PC (Wood has excellent thermal properties... right?)

  • A wooden weight bench (Splinters only make you stronger!)

If it exists ... you can probably make it out of wood!

🚚 Distribute

Load up your handcrafted chaos and ship it to the nearby city.

Earn money.
Reach new customers.
Confuse absolutely everyone.

🛒 Buy components

Can't chop it? Can’t craft it?
Buy it!
Use bought components to level up your character or jam them into your creations like a true artisan.

🌱 Start your business!

Begin with nothing but ambition and poor financial decisions.

Build your headquarters and expand into a world packed with secrets, resources and questionable business ethics.

🦆 Meet wacky characters

Meet quirky personalities, help them, befriend them and integrate them into your production chain
... completely voluntarily, of course ...

⚠️ Warning:
The ducks are up to something! 🦆
They know ...
You know they know ...🔪

🪑 Master furniture crafting

Build an ever-growing catalog of furniture using blueprints, rare materials and raw creative chaos.
Minimalism is optional. Overengineering is encouraged.

🏗️ Leave a mark

Upgrade the nearby city to unlock new customers, missions, secrets, and character upgrades.
Urban development has never involved this much ... wood.

💎 Unique trees

  • Stone trees

  • Metal trees

  • Electric trees

Nobody knows why they exist.
Your axe doesn’t care.

Uncover their mysterious origins as you progress ... or just chop first and ask questions later.

💪 Character stats

Improve your character by interacting with the world and using exercise equipment.
Yes, you can bench press your way to better woodworking.
No, we will not explain the science.

⚙️ Powerful upgrades

New machines.
Better axes.
"Smarter" distribution.

Automation that makes your empire run smoother than a freshly sanded plank.

🍲 Cooking

Turn resources into delicious meals that boost your stats.
Because nothing fuels industrial-scale lumber destruction like a hearty stew.

4380490.detailed_description:
A quiet island. A forgotten post office. And a mountain of undelivered mail.

You arrive just in time… or perhaps a little too late. The former postman has vanished, leaving chaos behind: parcels piled to the ceiling, customers growing impatient, and a once-thriving postal service on the brink of collapse.

One package at a time, you’ll bring it back to life.

Cat Mail Co. is about slowing down and enjoying the rhythm of small, satisfying tasks.

Incoming mail arrives by boat, and outgoing parcels must be carefully loaded for their journey.

Sort deliveries for the right destinations, or risk having them returned damaged. Take your time serving customers, organize your storage exactly the way you like, prepare for the next wave, and keep everything running smoothly as the post office slowly regains its former glory.

With each improvement, new destinations unlock, along with tools and abilities to help you manage the growing operation.

Every package tells you how it wants to be handled… but how you do it is up to you.

Weigh parcels to determine postage, apply destination labels, mark fragile or heavy goods, and decorate them with a variety of stamps. Functional or whimsical, every sticker you place adds personality to your work.

There’s no such thing as a “correct” way but just your way.

The post office doesn’t sleep… and neither do you.

As night settles in, moonlight reveals secrets. What seemed ordinary during the day may carry strange properties after dark, offering magical insight into how some parcels should be treated.

The routine continues, but in a magical way.

The massive backlog left behind isn’t just a task, it’s the story of the post office waiting to be uncovered.

Run the post office solo, or with friends.

With up to 4-player co-op, you can divide tasks, optimize your workflow, or simply enjoy the routine together. Whether you’re stamping, sorting, or loading the boat, teamwork makes the mail flow.

Cat Mail Co. Features

  • A cozy, stress-free gameplay loop with no timers or penalties

  • A satisfying package handling system: weigh, stamp, label, and sort

  • A meaningful day/night cycle with magical nighttime mechanics

  • A relaxing “pre-crastination” experience focused on preparation and flow

  • A post office in a cat's world to organize and restore

  • Up to 4-player cooperative gameplay

  • A narrative discovered through sorting parcels

4385270.name: Stay: Your Forever Pet!
4385270.detailed_description:
Join Our Community


About the Game

Meet Ember, Your Pet and New Best Friend

Take care of a furry friend in Stay: Your Forever Pet! In this cozy simulation game, explore a whimsical world, collecting resources and earning goods to accessorize your pet. Your Ember will bring magic and mischief into your space and take you on an adventure in a fantastical land. Believable behaviors and animation make Ember the world’s most spontaneous and vividly alive virtual pet ever made.

A Day with Ember

Every day with Ember follows a rhythm. You start by giving her what she wants to start the day, getting her ready for what's ahead. You can spend your downtime together, then set out on an expedition into the Shimmershift to recover her magic and just maybe, find her pack. Back home, you celebrate the day's finds, care for her, and wind down before it all begins again.

Low-Stress Gameplay

Play at your pace. You and your Ember work as a team to hunt for resources, banish thorny weeds, and explore the mysterious Shimmershift.

Craft Your Look

Use the resources you forage every day to trade for treats, toys, pet clothes, decorations, and more. There are dozens of toys and clothes to choose from -- 70 at launch -- find an outfit that suits your Ember’s unique look and personality.

Expeditions to the Shimmershift

Beyond your home lies hers: the Shimmershift, a strange wilderness where Ember's curiosity can run ahead of her caution. Embark on expeditions together: thorn-walled blockades that her magic can clear, sudden dangers to shelter her from, Mosslings to chase off, and quiet moments of wonder along the way. Ember can't do it alone. You read what she needs, call her back when she strays, steady her nerve, and decide together which path to take, spending her energy wisely so you both reach the end. Expeditions are the heart of Stay's adventure, and the system we'll keep deepening all through Early Access: new lands, new challenges, and new ways to face them, side by side.

Features

Care for and bond with a unique virtual pet

  • Lifelike behaviors and animation respond to the world as it's happening

  • Explore a whimsical Shimmershift together

  • Interact with Mosslings, delightful critters sometimes mischievous, other times helpful

  • Forage for resources while walking with your pet

  • Trade resources to receive decorations, accessories, treats, toys, and more

  • Dress up your companion to express your unique style

  • Customize your shared virtual yard 

These are the current features in Stay: Your Forever Pet! as early access. Additional content and new gameplay features will be added as the game further develops.

About the Team

Stay: Your Forever Pet! is made by an indie team who've spent their careers making creatures feel charming and alive on games like Plants vs Zombies 2, Peridot, and Beasts of Maravilla Island. It's Ember's second outing, following her VR debut in Stay: Forever Home.

4421010.name: Bills Must Be Paid
4421010.detailed_description:
Bills Must Be Paid is an active incremental game about paying your bills by smashing piggy banks.

Smash Piggy Banks

Smashing costs stamina. When your hand is getting tired the run is over.

Pay your bills

Bills show up. If you ignore them, bankruptcy will be your destiny. Pay them off to unlock perks that help you pay back your bills even faster.

Paying bills also gives you legacy points which you can spend on rings and bracelets to upgrade your hand after declaring bankruptcy.

 

Different piggy types

New types to discover. Some run away, some are too lazy to move, and others carry all the black money you never had :P...

Random loot

Piggies spawn random loot

You never know which one is holding the most, or do you?

Upgrades

A skill tree with multiple paths. Improve your grip strength, get addicted to caffeine, hit the gym, pump up your wrist, get more lucky, unlock abilities like rock rain, electrify your hammer, and more.

Different Hammers

Unlock different types of hammer. Some have higher crit chance and smaller radius, while others are super fast with big radius and less damage. Choose the one that better fits your own playstyle.

Collect rare coins

4450620.name: GRAIN ROT
4450620.detailed_description:
You are a Living Spark surviving inside fragile wooden vessels that splinter, collapse, and catch fire. When your vessel breaks, the Spark escapes. Death is just a change of scenery.

Ride a cursed elevator into shifting underground ruins with your crew. Smash furniture for resources or feed them into the Grinder for gold. If everyone breaks, your loot is lost.

Trolling can become your friend’s demise. Dropkick enemies or “accidentally” launch your ally’s Spark out of their vessel. Block them in a monster-infested corridor or get stuck in the crossfire. Will your group handle the chaos you created yourselves?

The deeper you go, the worse the Rot becomes. Bodies warp. Voices distort. Emotes become…worse. Or possibly better?

The Deep Layers are filled with Corrupted vessels, reacting to sound, movement, and each other in ways that are impossible to predict. Fight. Build. Run. Panic.

When your vessel breaks, you stay in the run as a Spark. Guide your team through the dark and search for another host with a new set of abilities. Force your way back in before you fade out completely.

Everything you haul back rebuilds your Outpost. Unlock interactive furniture, stat upgrades, rescued survivors, and stranger ways to survive the next descent. The stronger the outpost becomes, the deeper you can afford to go.

Go deeper. Extract more. Leave someone behind. Make it back and build together. 

Or don’t come back at all. 

FEATURES

  • Possess and swap between fragile wooden vessels

  • Co-op extraction horror with physics-driven chaos

  • Tactical carpentry with interactive furniture

  • Procedurally shifting underground dungeons

  • Persistent Outpost rebuilding and progression

  • Rage-bait your friends with cursed emotes

  • Rescue survivors trapped in the Deep Layers

  • Body corruption and mutation systems

  • Questionable cosmetics

4512570.name: A Game About Chopping Trees
4512570.detailed_description:
CHOP THE TREES

Leave the noise of the world behind and step into the quiet, rhythmic life of a woodsman. A Game About Chopping Trees is a meditative experience designed for players who find peace in simple, satisfying tasks, all wrapped in a calm and relaxing atmosphere with no timers, no pressure, and no stress. At its core, this is a game about the pure satisfaction of chopping trees.

EXPLORE

When it's time to move on to a new stretch of woodland, hop aboard your trusty handcar. Pump the levers and glide along the rails through serene, peaceful landscapes. The journey between forests is just as relaxing as the work itself. Simple. Satisfying. Entirely at your own pace.

UPGRADE

Enjoy the satisfying crack of timber as towering trees split and fall beneath your steady hand. As you make your way through the forest, invest your earnings to improve your chopping skills with upgrades such as a sharper ax, a stronger swing, and more efficient techniques that make every session feel even more rewarding.

GROW

The forest is a living cycle, and you can help it thrive. After clearing an area, take a moment to give back by planting new saplings in the spaces you've created. Watch your efforts take root as tiny sprouts gradually grow into towering trees once again. This gentle cycle of reforestation keeps the woodland lush and vibrant, allowing you to shape and nurture your own ever-changing forest.

4627110.name: Fell & Sell
4627110.detailed_description:
Why buy from heroes when you can be one?

Be the ultimate shopkeeper in a gorgeous, stylized fantasy world—but getting your stock means getting your hands dirty.
Step into a fast-paced 3D first-person hack'n'slash roguelike shopkeeper where your business success relies just as much on how hard you can swing a sword and how fast you can run as your trading skills.
Your inventory costs blood, sweat, and steel.

If you are reading this, you haven’t been slaughtered by a skeleton (yet?)—congratulations!

Study these sacred tenets to survive the dungeon depths, forge shop fixtures, and ruthlessly price your way to the top.

Step through the doors behind your shop into a descending roguelike nightmare, or head to the local forest to forage.

  • The Dungeon Demands a Toll: Carve your way through hordes of skeletons and monstrous foes. The deeper you go, the rarer the loot. But beware: if you die, you lose your entire unbanked haul.
    Do you secure the bag and head home, or risk it all for a legendary drop?

  • Crazy Build Potential: Find dungeon altars to alter your playstyle radically. Shrink down to a tiny size to dodge massive attacks, use the Midas Touch to melt heavy items into gold, or cycle through manic and depressed combat states to keep enemies guessing!

  • Survive the Living Forest: Nature has a mind of its own. Adapt on the fly to goblin raiding parties, sudden thunderstorms, and the mind-bending chaos of psychedelic mushroom season.

Surviving the wilds is only half the job. Once you make it back to your cabin in one piece, it's time to put your hard-earned materials and recipes to work.

  • Gear Up: Forge stronger weapons and craft tougher armor so you can push even deeper into the dungeon on your next run.

  • Check the Quest Board: Survived expedition? Make sure you stop by the local Quest Board to turn feats you've achieved during your expedition into gold, gear, and items.

  • Decorate (for Combat): Build specialized decor to customize your space. Your interior design isn't just cosmetic; the right furniture layout provides permanent combat buffs for your next dive and boosts your shop's overall sales appeal.

Unlock the front doors and let the gold flow.

  • Ruthless Economics: You control the tags. Read the market to set prices based on current supply, demand, your shop’s prestige, and your decoration bonuses.
    Find the sweet spot—price too high and goods gather dust; price too low, and you go bankrupt.

  • Grow Your Business: Take your massive profits and reinvest. Transform your humble roadside cabin into the ultimate mercantile powerhouse.

  • The Dungeon Demands a Toll: Carve your way through hordes of skeletons and monstrous foes. The deeper you go, the rarer the loot. But beware: if you die, you lose your entire unbanked haul.
    Do you secure the bag and head home, or risk it all for a legendary drop?

  • Crazy Build Potential: Find dungeon altars to alter your playstyle radically. Shrink down to a tiny size to dodge massive attacks, use the Midas Touch to melt heavy items into gold, or cycle through manic and depressed combat states to keep enemies guessing!

  • Survive the Living Forest: Nature has a mind of its own. Adapt on the fly to goblin raiding parties, sudden thunderstorms, and the mind-bending chaos of psychedelic mushroom season.

Surviving the wilds is only half the job. Once you make it back to your cabin in one piece, it's time to put your hard-earned materials and recipes to work.

  • Gear Up: Forge stronger weapons and craft tougher armor so you can push even deeper into the dungeon on your next run.

  • Check the Quest Board: Survived expedition? Make sure you stop by the local Quest Board to turn feats you've achieved during your expedition into gold, gear, and items.

  • Decorate (for Combat): Build specialized decor to customize your space. Your interior design isn't just cosmetic; the right furniture layout provides permanent combat buffs for your next dive and boosts your shop's overall sales appeal.

Unlock the front doors and let the gold flow.

  • Ruthless Economics: You control the tags. Read the market to set prices based on current supply, demand, your shop’s prestige, and your decoration bonuses.
    Find the sweet spot—price too high and goods gather dust; price too low, and you go bankrupt.

  • Grow Your Business: Take your massive profits and reinvest. Transform your humble roadside cabin into the ultimate mercantile powerhouse.
4627110.short_description: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

yeah! Mechcha "Hide and Seek"

4731620.name: Fortune Mill
4731620.detailed_description:
Start with $0 and work your way up to $1,000,000

Your first throw earns $1 gold, one million seems impossible...
But then you buy +750% gold value upgrades, unlock the Rattling Gunner, throw double-darts, and before you know it you're earning $250,000 per throw! Gold is raining down, waiting to be collected.

Each room has new gameplay mechanics

Your first scratcher earns you $6, one million seems impossible...
But then you buy BIGGER tickets worth $100,000+, hire a tax-cheating Toad Accountant, and even win a jackpot for a golden dart-gun for your Rattling Gunner - that's right, each room 

Each room has Automation & Bonuses which helps other rooms

Hit JACKPOTS in Room 2 for big permanent bonuses to all rooms!
Roll DICE in Room 3 for massive multipliers to earnings in all rooms!
Cook SUSHI in Room 4 for unique game-altering effects for all rooms!

You were meant to be packaged into Box #724

Now you're crawling through a crack in the wall, no idea where it goes, hoping it's a way out...

FULL GAMEPLAY FEATURES:

  • Multiple different rooms full of unique games - Darts, Scratch-offs, Pachinko, and several more.

  • Full Automation across the game, no matter which room you're in!

  • 120+ unique upgrades which affect gameplay in increasingly meaningful ways.

  • Special upgrades that affect ALL rooms - each room affects the others.

  • "New Game+" bonus modes, each with unique exclusive upgrades that give huge replay value beyond your 1st run.

  • Lethal Mode, an (optional) official speedrun mode that rewards strategic gameplay after your 1st run.

  • 15 different creatures to befriend or bribe - from Bubba the Seal, to the iconic Abacus Frog!

Will you make $1,000,000 and escape the FORTUNE MILL?

4800590.name: Supermarket Chaos
4800590.detailed_description:
Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator about calmly putting a chaotic supermarket back in order. Arrange 4,668 products across 16 sections, including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every shelf feel right.

〖A Relaxing Supermarket Organizing Simulator〗

One day, the store-organizing robot GPT-9000 reached a philosophical conclusion: “All positions are temporary, and all displays are violence.” As a result, every product in the supermarket lost its place. (Fortunately, he was fired immediately.)

No need to worry. Now all you have to do is walk through the quiet store and return each scattered product to its proper place.

〖Major Update #1: Choose Your Map〗

A supermarket, a convenience store straight out of a dream, and even the Super Super Supermarket—choose the map that suits you and start organizing.

  • The original supermarket map has been revamped to support symmetrical product placement, and its product count has increased to 4,669.

  • (Patch 1.1.6) The Super Super Market has been updated. Try organizing 9,999 items!

〖Major Update #2: Organize with Friends!〗

Up to 4 players can now organize together. Dress up in a variety of costumes and team up with your friends to put everything back in order. (Friends sold separately.)

〖When a Messy Store Falls Into Place〗

At first, the store is a little chaotic.
Empty shelves, products left on the floor, sections that still need attention.
But as you put each item back where it belongs, the store gradually becomes a clean, comfortable space.

〖Pick Up Products, Find Their Sections, and Put Them in Place〗

Pick up each product, find the right section, and match it to the correct price tag.
Instead of rushing, settle into the rhythm of organizing and take your time completing the store.

〖One Completed Section, One Quiet Satisfaction〗

Empty shelves fill up with products, and mixed-up items settle into neat rows.
Each completed section brings visible progress and a quiet sense of satisfaction.

〖Skill Upgrades〗

Unlock and upgrade a variety of skills as you play.
Carry more products, find the spots you need more easily, and make the whole organizing process smoother and more efficient.

〖Key Features〗

  • A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 4,000 products

  • 16 sections including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more

  • Gameplay focused on checking item names and locations, then placing them where they belong

  • The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner

  • A variety of skill upgrades for movement, carrying, searching, and more

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace

  • Multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • 3 unique maps to put back in order

4927490.name: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
4927490.detailed_description:
Synopsis

 When's the worst time to be the janitor of a puzzle gallery? After an earthquake, of course! You play as the janitor of a puzzle gallery, and an earthquake has scattered all of the 2000+ pieces everywhere. Your job is to use your puzzling skills (and some added enhancements) to put all of the pieces back in their place.

The Ultimate Challenge or the Coziest Simulator

Listen to classical music and admire famous paintings as you solve 87 jigsaw puzzles of varying shapes, subjects, and sizes. Whether you want to see how fast you can solve every one by min-maxing various abilities and sprinting across the gallery, or you just want to chill and work on some puzzles, this clean up simulator is right for you.

A Gallery Of Masterpieces...

The gallery is home to 87 paintings from 13 famous artists such as Monet, Van Gogh, Hokusai, and more, ensuring each piece and section is visually unique and distinctive from the others. Each of the paintings was sourced from Public Domain scans and photographs of their museum originals.

... Or Curated by YOU

4928820.name: Shelve the Potions!
4928820.detailed_description:
Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

The witch had to leave on urgent business. By the time you arrive for your very first day as her apprentice. Her mischievous cats have knocked every potion off the shelves, turning the workshop into complete chaos. To leave a good first impression, we might as well put them back up.

Gameplay

Each shelf is its own handcrafted puzzle with unique rules waiting to be discovered. Sort and organize over 2,000+ potions, learning how every order works through experimentation, logic, and observation.

Some puzzles can be solved at a glance, while others require finding hidden clues, using special items, or connecting information you've learned elsewhere in the workshop.

Whenever you feel stuck, Pet the magical cats, then ask them for hints. They'll point you toward missing potions, highlight important clues, or even reveal part of a puzzle's solution when you need a little extra help.

Features

  • 20+ handcrafted potion-sorting puzzles with unique rules to discover.

  • Organize and sort 2,000+ unique potions throughout the workshop.

  • Relaxing gameplay with no timers or penalties.

  • Cozy fantasy atmosphere inspired by witches, and alchemy.

  • Cute cats!

4934370.detailed_description:
This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive.

Game Modes

Solo, together, or competition...

Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP.

You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself.

Videotape Categories

Your task is to shelve 3,180 videotapes into the correct categories in the archive.

Action movies, drama movies, TV series, cartoons, horror movies, comedy movies, athletic games, football cups, romance movies, sci-fi movies, baseball, tennis, news, game shows, basketball, motorsport, cooking shows, documentaries, boxing, and talk shows.

Skills

  • Sorting Numerically: Sorts the videotapes in your hand in numerical order

  • Highlighting Shelf: Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Highlighting Videotapes: Highlights the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Auto-Placement: Automatically places your videotapes on the shelf in the correct order

  • Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

【A Cozy Cellar Organization Simulator】

A once-pristine cellar has fallen into complete disarray.

Return 2,448 bottles to their proper racks by identifying their varieties and restoring perfect order throughout the cellar.

 【The Forgotten Keeper】

Long ago, the cellar belonged to an eccentric collector who loved his bottle collection more than anything else.

Desperate to preserve it forever, he attempted an ancient spell. The cellar survived... but the spell turned him into a chicken and trapped him inside a small cage.

Now the cellar has fallen into ruin.

Restore every rack, break the curse, and help the forgotten keeper see the sunlight once again.

The cellar starts in complete chaos.

As you organize each rack, the room gradually transforms into a clean, beautiful collection.

Watching disorder disappear is its own reward.

Unlock powerful abilities that improve carrying, searching, and movement.

Choose your upgrades wisely and discover the most efficient way to organize the cellar.

NO AI WAS USED IN THE MAKING OF THIS GAME

Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your fantasy Adventurer's shop. An evil wizard has blasted thousands of your products all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

Shop Restoration

Item by item you'll build the shop back to its former tidiness. There's an incredible range of products ranging from potions to sushi. Those Greatswords really shouldn't be mixing with the pineapples...

Multiplayer

It's a mighty big puzzle to solve. Maybe some friends could help you out?

Don't worry if you'd prefer to tidy at your own pace; the game is also perfect in single player!

Abilities

That wizard isn't the only one who knows some magic. As you tidy you'll be inspired to learn new abilities to help maximise your efficiency.

  • Multiplayer - Invite as many friends as you like to help you out.

  • Full Controller support.

  • 650, 2500 and almost 10,000 items across 14 categories and three shops.

  • Ability upgrades.

  • No time limits (but you can see completion time at the end) and no game over. Tidy Up at your own pace!

4992070.name: Sort Them Ducks
4992070.detailed_description:
Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where your goal is simple: pick up rubber ducks and place them on the correct shelves. Discover thousands of unique ducks, unlock helpful abilities, and transform a cluttered store into a perfectly organized collection—one duck at a time.

A Cozy Duck Sorting Simulator

Thousands of rubber ducks have been delivered, but they're completely mixed up. Pirate ducks, wizard ducks, astronauts, knights, chefs, dinosaurs, and many more are scattered throughout the store. It's your job to sort every duck into its proper category and bring order back to the shelves.

No rush. No pressure. Just ducks.

From Complete Chaos to Perfect Order

Every shelf starts empty, and ducks are everywhere.

As you organize the store, shelves slowly fill with colorful collections, making every section feel more complete. Watching the store transform from a mess into a perfectly organized display is satisfying every step of the way.

Collect, Sort, Repeat

Pick up ducks from around the store, identify their category, and place them on the correct shelf.

The better you know your ducks, the faster you'll organize the store. Every correctly sorted duck earns money to help you improve your abilities.

Upgrade Your Duck Sorting Skills

Unlock powerful upgrades that make organizing even more satisfying.

Carry more ducks at once, move faster, highlight matching ducks, reveal the correct shelf, automatically collect nearby ducks, and unlock even more abilities as your collection grows.

Thousands of Ducks to Discover

With over 4,000 unique rubber ducks, every shelf offers something new.

Complete themed collections, learn each category, and enjoy filling the store with colorful displays of quirky ducks.

Key Features

🦆 Sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks into their correct shelves.

🏪 Organize a colorful duck store filled with themed collections.

💰 Earn money for every correctly sorted duck.

⭐ Unlock upgrades that improve carrying, movement, searching, and organization.

📚 Discover hundreds of duck categories and complete every shelf.

🎮 Relaxing, satisfying gameplay with no time limits or penalties.

✨ Watch the store transform from complete chaos into a perfectly organized duck paradise.
